title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEDUCTION AND WITHHOLDING OF PERSONAL INCOME TAX FROM PENSION PAYMENTS AND ANNUITY DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that payers deduct and withhold personal income tax from lump-sum payments of pension payments and annuity distributions.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR MILITARY FUNERAL HONOR GUARD DETAIL COMPENSATION.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for any compensation received by a taxpayer for attending a funeral as a member of an honor guard detail pursuant to section 27-76 of the general statutes.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION OF A TRAIN STATION IN THE TOWN OF NEWINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding for the design and construction of a train station in the town of Newington.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE METHODOLOGY USED TO ADJUST THE VOLATILITY CAP TRANSFER THRESHOLD.
purpose: To amend the methodology used to calculate the annual adjustment to the threshold amount of the revenue transfer under section 4-30a of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTATE AND GIFT TAXES AND THE USE OF THE REVENUE GENERATED FROM SUCH TAXES.
purpose: To reduce the estate tax exemption threshold to three million six hundred thousand dollars and eliminate the caps on estate and gift taxes, and deposit the revenue from such taxes in the Early Childhood Education Fund.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAPITAL GAINS SURCHARGE AND CONCERNING THE USE OF THE REVENUE GENERATED FROM SUCH SURCHARGE.
purpose: To establish a capital gains surcharge on certain taxpayers, to be deposited in the Early Childhood Education Fund.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION AND ANNUITY INCOME AND DISTRIBUTIONS FROM CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To replace the current personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension and annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts and eliminate the marriage penalty.

title: AN ACT DEDICATING THE SALES AND USE TAXES REVENUE GENERATED FROM ALCOHOL SALES TO CERTAIN PURPOSES.
purpose: To dedicate all sales and use taxes revenue generated from the sale, acceptance or receipt in this state of alcohol to rehabilitation and treatment programs, drunk driving prevention efforts and the establishment of a recovery school.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SELECTION OF THE PRESIDING OFFICER FOR AN AGENCY PROCEEDING HEARING.
purpose: To prevent conflicts of interest in agency proceedings by prohibiting the presiding officer in an agency proceeding hearing from being a member or employee of the agency.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PRESENTATION OF PHOTO IDENTIFICATION TO VOTE.
purpose: To require presentation of photo identification to vote.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT WITHDRAWING CONNECTICUT FROM THE NATIONAL POPULAR VOTE INTERSTATE COMPACT.
purpose: To withdraw the state from the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING THE SPRING PEEPER AS THE STATE AMPHIBIAN.
purpose: To designate the spring peeper as the state amphibian.
cosponsors: Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONNECTICUT CRAFT CAFE LIQUOR PERMITTEES.
purpose: To enable Connecticut craft cafe permittees to apply to expand their permit premises to include premises with separate addresses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BUILDING TRADE OCCUPATIONAL LICENSES.
purpose: To consolidate building trade occupational licenses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MOTOR VEHICLE DATA PRIVACY AND VICTIMS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To provide for the termination of, and require disclosure regarding the use of, remote vehicle technology.
cosponsors: Sen. Saud Anwar, 3rd Dist.; Rep. Roland J. Lemar, 96th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MOTOR VEHICLE DATA PRIVACY.
purpose: To prohibit motor vehicle manufacturers and certain technology platforms from collecting or selling certain motor vehicle data without motor vehicle owners' consent.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING BUSINESS ENTITIES TO PROVIDE ITEMIZED RECEIPTS TO CERTAIN CONSUMERS.
purpose: To require business entities to, upon request, provide itemized receipts to certain consumers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PAYMENT OF CERTAIN PERSONAL PROPERTY TAXES AS A PRECONDITION TO PROFESSIONAL AND OCCUPATIONAL LICENSE RENEWALS.
purpose: To require an applicant seeking renewal of a professional or occupational license to demonstrate that the applicant does not owe any taxes assessed against the personal property that such applicant uses in the course of such applicant's profession or occupation.

primary_sponsors: REP. TAMI ZAWISTOWSKI, 61st DIST.; REP. DAVID RUTIGLIANO, 123rd DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CANNABIS CONSUMPTION AT LOCATIONS WHERE TOBACCO USE IS PROHIBITED.
purpose: To prohibit cannabis consumption at locations where tobacco use is prohibited.
introduced_by: REP. ZAWISTOWSKI, 61st Dist.; REP. RUTIGLIANO, 123rd Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. TAMI ZAWISTOWSKI, 61st DIST.; REP. DAVID RUTIGLIANO, 123rd DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CANNABIS CONSUMPTION AT LOCATIONS WHERE ALCOHOL CONSUMPTION IS PROHIBITED.
purpose: To prohibit cannabis consumption at locations where alcohol consumption is prohibited.
introduced_by: REP. ZAWISTOWSKI, 61st Dist.; REP. RUTIGLIANO, 123rd Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING RETAILERS TO DISCLOSE HEALTH RISKS POSED BY CONTACT LENSES.
purpose: To require retailers that sell, fit or otherwise provide contact lenses to consumers to disclose to consumers, at the point of sale, that wearing contact lenses while engaging in certain activities poses certain health risks.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE DEBT-FREE COMMUNITY COLLEGE PROGRAM TO INCLUDE CONNECTICUT STATE UNIVERSITY STUDENTS.
purpose: To expand the debt-free community college program to include students enrolled at a state university within the Connecticut State University System.
cosponsors: Rep. Corey P. Paris, 145th Dist.

primary_sponsors: Higher Education and Employment Advancement Committee
title: AN ACT CONCERNING FEES CHARGED BY INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To (1) prohibit institutions of higher education from charging fees to students that are not part of tuition and room and board costs, and not disclosed prior to requiring an enrollment deposit; and (2) require institutions of higher education to return unexpended meal plan funds.
cosponsors: Rep. Gary A. Turco, 27th Dist.; Rep. Sarah Keitt, 134th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LOANS MADE BY THE CONNECTICUT HOUSING FINANCE AUTHORITY.
purpose: To require the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority to prioritize issuing loans for properties purchased in a municipality containing seven thousand five hundred or fewer residents.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS AND CLINICAL LABORATORIES FROM IMPOSING OUT-OF-POCKET EXPENSES BASED ON ESTIMATES OF CHARGES.
purpose: To prohibit any health care provider or clinical laboratory from imposing, for health care services or treatment rendered to an insured, a coinsurance, copayment, deductible or other out-of-pocket expense at the time of such service or treatment based on an estimate of charges, rather than an amount identified in the medical bill for such service or treatment.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING RESIDENTIAL REAL PROPERTY TRANSACTIONS THAT CONDITION THE SALE OF PROPERTY ON HOME INSPECTION LIMITATIONS.
purpose: To prohibit a seller of residential real property from (1) conditioning the sale of such property on the prospective buyer waiving or limiting a home inspection of such property, or (2) accepting an offer from such prospective buyer if such seller has been informed in advance that such prospective buyer intends to waive or limit such prospective buyer's right to a home inspection of such property.
cosponsors: Sen. Matthew L. Lesser, 9th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. GARY A. TURCO, 27th DIST.; REP. JAIME S. FOSTER, 57th DIST.; REP. ELENI KAVROS DEGRAW, 17th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR DIAGNOSTIC AND SCREENING COLONOSCOPIES.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide full health insurance coverage, without any out-of-pocket expense, for (1) diagnostic and screening colonoscopies, and (2) any necessary medical procedure preparation when recommended by a health care provider within such provider's scope of practice.
cosponsors: Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.; Rep. Ronald A. Napoli, 73rd Dist.
introduced_by: REP. TURCO, 27th Dist.; REP. FOSTER, 57th Dist.; REP. KAVROS DEGRAW, 17th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRESCRIPTION DRUG COSTS.
purpose: To (1) apply all available discounts or coupons for any prescription drug, and (2) notify customers, before presenting any prescription drug to such customer, of any available prescription drug discount programs and generic prescription drug alternatives that may lower the price of such prescription drug.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A POLICE OFFICER'S ABILITY TO REQUEST CONSENT TO SEARCH A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To allow police officers the ability to request consent to search a motor vehicle in order to take illegal weapons and drugs off the street, as well as assist in collecting evidence of a crime.
cosponsors: Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.; Rep. Renee LaMark Muir, 36th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING USE OF DEADLY FORCE.
purpose: To ensure that peace officers are properly evaluated for the use of force.
cosponsors: Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. GREG S. HOWARD, 43rd DIST.; REP. LIZ LINEHAN, 103rd DIST.
title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR POSSESSION OF CHILD PORNOGRAPHY.
purpose: To increase the penalty for possession of child pornography.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.; Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.
introduced_by: REP. HOWARD, 43rd Dist.; REP. LINEHAN, 103rd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity related to qualified immunity for law enforcement officers and provide guidance for such officers regarding lawful actions in the field.
cosponsors: Rep. Mitch Bolinsky, 106th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE FILING FEE FOR ANNUAL REPORTS FILED BY LIMITED PARTNERSHIPS, LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANIES AND LIMITED LIABILITY PARTNERSHIPS.
purpose: To reduce the filing fee for annual reports filed by limited partnerships, limited liability companies and limited liability partnerships from eighty dollars to twenty dollars.

title: AN ACT ADOPTING THE UNIFORM REAL PROPERTY TRANSFER ON DEATH ACT.
purpose: To allow an owner of real property to pass the property simply and directly by operation of law to a beneficiary upon the owner's death.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HABEAS CORPUS PROCEEDINGS.
purpose: To revise habeas corpus proceedings in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGAL LIABILITY FOR AGRICULTURAL OPERATIONS THAT ARE ENGAGED IN AGRITOURISM.
purpose: To limit the liability of agricultural operators engaged in agritourism in the state.

title: AN ACT CREATING THE OPTION TO NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE INSURANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To allow an employee to opt out of both making contributions to and filing a claim for benefits from the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PUBLIC EMPLOYEE'S RIGHT TO BE A MEMBER OF A UNION.
purpose: To provide clear disclosures on state and municipal collective bargaining agreements of an employee's right to opt out of membership in a union.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' SELECTION OF AN EXCLUSIVE BARGAINING UNIT.
purpose: To protect public employees' right to elect a union of their choice to represent their interests.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NOTICE OF TAXES DUE TO MUNICIPAL TAX COLLECTORS.
purpose: To allow municipal tax collectors to publish notice of due taxes in newspapers of general circulation not published in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF CERTIFICATES OF OCCUPANCY.
purpose: To ensure developer compliance with site plans approved by municipal zoning commissions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TAX ASSESSMENT OF COMMON INTEREST COMMUNITY UNITS UPON THE REDUCTION OF MUNICIPAL SERVICES.
purpose: To allow a municipality to reduce the assessed value of any unit located in a common interest community when such unit no longer receives certain municipal services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MUNICIPAL REGULATION OF STREET TAKEOVERS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to adopt ordinances that penalize street takeovers.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE ONLINE PUBLICATION OF MUNICIPAL LEGAL NOTICES.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to post legal notices on municipal Internet web sites in lieu of publication in a newspaper.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL REGULATIONS FOR NONRESIDENTIAL SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC SYSTEMS.
purpose: To require solar farms to comply with local planning and zoning laws.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL APPROVAL FOR CERTAIN NONRESIDENTIAL SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC FACILITIES.
purpose: To allow any municipality with two or more existing nonresidential solar photovoltaic facilities located within such municipality to (1) approve or reject subsequent nonresidential solar photovoltaic facilities proposed for construction or installation in such municipality, and (2) impose a moratorium on the construction or installation of such facilities within such municipality.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN LENDING PRACTICES BY HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To prohibit health care providers from engaging in certain lending practices.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE REQUIREMENTS TO OBTAIN A CERTIFICATE OF NEED TO ESTABLISH NEW HEALTH CARE FACILITIES OR SERVICES AND TRANSFER OWNERSHIP OF EXISTING HEALTH CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To promote the expansion of and access to health care services in the state by requiring certificate of need approval only for the termination of existing facilities and services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEATH CERTIFICATES.
purpose: To require registrars of vital statistics to issue standard death certificates and short form death certificates.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.; Rep. William Pizzuto, 71st Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING LICENSURE OF ACUTE CARE HOSPITALS THAT LEASE PROPERTY OWNED BY REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUSTS.
purpose: To prohibit ownership of hospitals by real estate investment trusts.
cosponsors: Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.; Sen. MD Rahman, 4th Dist.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING A MORAL OR PHILOSOPHICAL OBJECTION AS AN EXEMPTION FROM SCHOOL IMMUNIZATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To allow a moral or philosophical objection as an exemption from school immunization requirements.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TERMINATION OF INPATIENT OR OUTPATIENT SERVICES OFFERED BY A HOSPITAL.
purpose: To (1) prohibit the termination of inpatient or outpatient services provided by a hospital without clear and convincing evidence that such termination would not decrease health care accessibility or affordability in the affected area, (2) require the notification of the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to public health regarding the need for termination of any inpatient or outpatient services offered by a hospital, and (3) prohibit the overturning of a decision made by the Office of Health Strategy denying an application for a certificate of need for termination of inpatient or outpatient services offered by a hospital absent new evidence.
cosponsors: Sen. Jeff Gordon, 35th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING WRITTEN NOTICE REGARDING MEDICAL RECORDS.
purpose: To provide transparency to patients regarding the storage and maintenance of their medical records by health care providers.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT REDEFINING "LARGE CAPACITY MAGAZINE".
purpose: To allow the possession of a firearm magazine that has the capacity of not more than fifteen rounds of ammunition.
cosponsors: Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING THE PURCHASE, POSSESSION AND IMPORTATION OF LARGE CAPACITY MAGAZINES BY CERTAIN PERSONS.
purpose: To allow the purchase, possession and importation of large capacity magazines by (1) a licensed security guard while in the performance of such licensed security guard's duties, and (2) a holder of a photographic identification issued under the federal Law Enforcement Officers Safety Act.
cosponsors: Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY TO LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE REVISION OF THE MODEL PURSUIT POLICY TO ALLOW POLICE OFFICERS TO PURSUE INDIVIDUALS SUSPECTED OF COMMITTING CERTAIN PROPERTY CRIMES.
purpose: To better protect the public by allowing police officers to pursue individuals suspected of committing certain property crimes.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE SALE OF CONSUMER FIREWORKS.
purpose: To authorize the sale of consumer fireworks in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR DRUG RECOGNITION EXPERT TRAINING FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To provide funding for drug recognition expert training so that law enforcement officers can identify motor vehicle operators who are operating under the influence of cannabis or a substance other than alcohol.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OFF-DUTY LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS TO CARRY FIREARMS ON SCHOOL GROUNDS.
purpose: To allow off-duty law enforcement officers to carry firearms on school grounds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF A POLICE OFFICER TO TRANSPORT A PERSON TO AN EMERGENCY ROOM OR A SUBSTANCE ABUSE FACILITY.
purpose: To allow a police officer to take a person into protective custody and transport such person to an emergency room or a substance abuse facility if the officer has administered an opioid antagonist to such person or taken other lifesaving measures.

title: AN ACT LIMITING ORDERS RELATED TO FIREARMS AND AMMUNITION DURING A CIVIL PREPAREDNESS OR PUBLIC HEALTH EMERGENCY.
purpose: To prohibit the Governor or any municipality from restricting lawful possession of a firearm or ammunition during a civil preparedness or public health emergency.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Doug Dubitsky, 47th Dist.; Rep. Karen Reddington-Hughes, 66th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.; Rep. Joe Hoxha, 78th Dist.; Rep. Donna Veach, 30th Dist.; Rep. Brian Lanoue, 45th Dist.; Rep. Kurt Vail, 52nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE OF AMMUNITION AT GUN CLUBS AND FIREARM RANGES.
purpose: To allow a gun club or firearm range to sell ammunition for use at such club or range to any person without requiring such person to hold a valid ammunition certificate.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.; Rep. Greg S. Howard, 43rd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPLIANCE WITH A REQUIREMENT THAT CERTAIN INFORMATION REGARDING FIREARMS BE PUBLICLY POSTED.
purpose: To determine the level of compliance with the requirement to publicly post information about firearm permitting rights specified in section 29-32c of the general statutes.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POLICE OFFICER DISCRETION TO PURSUE A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To provide discretion to a police officer to pursue a motor vehicle if such officer can articulate a public safety need for such pursuit.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MAILING OF A MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION APPLICATION.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to mail a motor vehicle registration application to a registrant.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING TOWING COMPANIES TO ACCEPT ALTERNATIVE FORMS OF PAYMENT.
purpose: To require towing companies to accept alternative forms of payment for towing and storage charges.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING WRECKERS TO USE BLUE LIGHTS WHILE PREPARING TO TOW MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To provide wrecker operators with greater safety while clearing the state's roads of damaged or disabled motor vehicles.
cosponsors: Rep. Ben McGorty, 122nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF SIX-INCH-WIDE EDGE LINES ON LIMITED ACCESS HIGHWAYS.
purpose: To decrease fatal traffic crashes in the state by installing six-inch-wide edge lines on limited access highways.

title: AN ACT NAMING AN OVERPASS IN THE TOWN OF SOUTHINGTON IN HONOR OF TROOPER FIRST CLASS AARON PELLETIER.
purpose: To name an overpass in the town of Southington in honor of Trooper First Class Aaron Pelletier, who tragically died in the line of duty.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT NAMING AN OVERPASS IN THE TOWN OF BERLIN IN HONOR OF GOLD STAR FAMILIES.
purpose: To name an overpass in the town of Berlin in honor of the families of military members who were killed in action while performing active military duty with the armed forces of the United States.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING VETERANS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE.
purpose: To exempt veterans from the Passport to the Parks fee.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING SERVICE IN TIME OF WAR AS AN ELIGIBILITY CRITERION FOR CERTAIN STATE AND MUNICIPAL VETERANS' BENEFITS.
purpose: To eliminate service in time of war as an eligibility criterion for certain state and municipal veterans' benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR GIRLS FOR TECHNOLOGY.
purpose: To support Girls for Technology activities to address systemic inequities affecting underrepresented and low-income communities across the state, particularly in Hartford, New Haven and New London counties and ensure measurable outcomes in financial literacy, workforce readiness and technological proficiency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF "DONATE LIFE" NUMBER PLATES.
purpose: To create a special license plate to enhance public awareness of the importance of organ and tissue donations.
cosponsors: Rep. Gary A. Turco, 27th Dist.; Rep. Corey P. Paris, 145th Dist.; Rep. Geraldo C. Reyes, 75th Dist.; Rep. Frank Smith, 118th Dist.; Rep. Farley Santos, 109th Dist.; Rep. Kara Rochelle, 104th Dist.; Rep. Larry B. Butler, 72nd Dist.; Rep. Kenneth Gucker, 138th Dist.; Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.; Rep. Jill Barry, 31st Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE FARMERS' MARKET NUTRITION PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase funds for the farmers' market nutrition program to expand access to fresh, locally grown produce for low-income individuals and families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE CT GROWN FOR CT KIDS GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase funding for the CT Grown for CT Kids grant program, promote the purchase of locally grown food and provide healthier food options for school students.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCREASED ACCESS TO FREE SCHOOL MEALS.
purpose: To ensure that all students, regardless of which school they are enrolled, have access to free school meals in order to support the health and well-being of children from low-income families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CALCULATION OF MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To exclude one-time, nonrecurring, non-General Fund revenues from counting toward the budgeted appropriation for education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENT DURING A SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION PROJECT.
purpose: To waive the minimum budget requirement when a school is closed due to a school construction project.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING NEWSPAPER DELIVERY TO NON-SUBSCRIBERS.
purpose: To reduce the environmental impacts from unsolicited newspapers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMPOSITION OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY, COMMUNICATIONS BY PUBLIC UTILITY COMPANIES AND THE ADMINISTRATION OF ENERGY EFFICIENCY PROGRAMS.
purpose: To (1) prohibit any public service company from charging a fee to any customer of such company in connection with a communication from such company to such customer, (2) provide that any legislator or the chief executive officer of any municipality may intervene and be granted party status in any proceeding before the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority, (3) specify minimum education requirements for each person appointed to the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority with a preference for individuals who are accountants, auditors and engineers with infrastructure estimating experience, (4) make any communication by a public utility company subject to the Freedom of Information Act, (5) require a minimum notification period and standards for notices to customers of any public utility company concerning rate changes, (6) require that any energy efficiency programs in the state be administered by a not-for-profit entity, and (7) require that any vacancy on the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority be promptly filled by appointment.
cosponsors: Rep. Lucy Dathan, 142nd Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRID-ENHANCING TECHNOLOGY TASK FORCE.
purpose: To establish a task force to study transmission infrastructure and the potential use of grid-enhancing technologies, including dynamic line rating and advanced power flow control, in the state.
cosponsors: Rep. Lucy Dathan, 142nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR CERTAIN RENEWABLE ENERGY SYSTEMS.
purpose: To create property tax exemptions for certain renewable energy systems, including solar, geothermal and hydropower systems, and other Class I renewable energy sources, based on the installation date, generation capacity and location of such systems.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TAX INCENTIVES FOR THE INSTALLATION OF RENEWABLE ENERGY SYSTEMS.
purpose: To clarify criteria for property tax exemptions for renewable energy systems and to simplify the application process for such exemptions.

title: AN ACT EXPEDITING CONTRACT EXECUTION FOR STATE PURCHASE OF SERVICE CONTRACTS.
purpose: To require the expediting the execution of state purchase of service contracts to help organizations that rely on state funding avoid delays in receiving reimbursements and payments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EARLY VOTING FOR SINGULAR, UNCONTESTED SPECIAL ELECTIONS.
purpose: To allow municipalities to opt out of conducting early voting for singular, uncontested special elections.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE OF SMALL BOTTLES OF ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR.
purpose: To prohibit the sale of any bottle of alcoholic liquor that is fifty milliliters or less in volume.

primary_sponsors: REP. JAIME S. FOSTER, 57th DIST.; SEN. SAUD ANWAR, 3rd DIST.; REP. KAI J. BELTON, 100th DIST.; SEN. MATTHEW L. LESSER, 9th DIST.; REP. MARCUS BROWN, 127th DIST.; REP. KEVIN BROWN, 56th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR CHILD CARE PROVIDERS UNDER THE STATE EMPLOYEE HEALTH PLAN.
purpose: To allow any child care provider, including, but not limited to, any home child care provider, to participate in the state employee health plan.
cosponsors: Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. FOSTER, 57th Dist.; SEN. ANWAR, 3rd Dist.; REP. BELTON, 100th Dist. SEN. LESSER, 9th Dist.; REP. BROWN, 127th Dist.; REP. BROWN, 56th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CRYPTOCURRENCY, PIG BUTCHERING SCAMS AND ASSET FORFEITURE.
purpose: To establish specific penal code and procedural provisions concerning crimes related to cryptocurrency and pig butchering scams.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE CAPITAL REGION DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To add a member representing the town of East Windsor to the board of directors of the Capital Region Development Authority.

title: AN ACT CLASSIFYING FIRST RESPONDERS AS ESSENTIAL SERVICES PROVIDERS.
purpose: To classify first responders as essential services providers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PLACEMENT OF TRAFFIC CONES AROUND CERTAIN LANDSCAPING VEHICLES WHEN PARKED ON A PUBLIC HIGHWAY.
purpose: To require the placement of traffic cones around certain landscaping vehicles when parked on a public highway.
cosponsors: Rep. Jaime S. Foster, 57th Dist.; Rep. Amy Morrin Bello, 28th Dist.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING WEIGH-IN-MOTION SYSTEMS FOR COMMERCIAL MOTOR VEHICLE ENFORCEMENT ACTIVITIES.
purpose: To require the Departments of Motor Vehicles, Transportation and Emergency Services and Public Protection to expand the use of weigh-in-motion systems for commercial motor vehicle enforcement activities.
cosponsors: Rep. Jaime S. Foster, 57th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SURVIVING SPOUSES' ELIGIBILITY FOR A CERTAIN VETERANS' PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION.
purpose: To expand eligibility for a certain veterans' property tax exemption to the surviving spouses of veterans who passed away prior to the effective date of such exemption.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.; Rep. Sarah Keitt, 134th Dist.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING THE LAND ON WHICH A DWELLING SITS IN THE PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION FOR VETERANS WITH A SERVICE-CONNECTED PERMANENT AND TOTAL DISABILITY RATING.
purpose: To include the land on which a dwelling sits, in addition to the dwelling itself, in a certain veterans property tax exemption.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REAL PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENTS FOR CERTAIN FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYERS.
purpose: To establish a municipal option for a property tax abatement for certain first-time homebuyers.

title: AN ACT REDUCING INTEREST DUE ON CERTAIN UNPAID MUNICIPAL PROPERTY TAXES.
purpose: To reduce from eighteen per cent to twelve per cent the annual interest due on unpaid municipal property taxes when a municipal tax collector files a lien on a property and such lien is assigned to a third party.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF BLUE LIGHTS ON MOTOR VEHICLES OPERATED BY ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICE COMPANIES.
purpose: To improve the safety and response time of environmental service companies when such companies are requested by the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to clean a contaminated accident scene.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To automatically adjust state funding for nonprofit organizations to align with annual inflation rates.
cosponsors: Rep. Nicholas Menapace, 37th Dist.; Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.; Rep. Laurie Sweet, 91st Dist.; Sen. Herron Gaston, 23rd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVER PROCESS FOR THE COMPREHENSIVE READING CURRICULUM MODEL OR PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To amend the waiver process for the comprehensive reading curriculum model or program requirements.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING AN EXEMPTION FROM THE READING CURRICULUM MODEL OR PROGRAM REQUIREMENT FOR CERTAIN SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To exempt high-performing school districts from the requirements of the state-mandated reading curriculum.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE MANDATE THAT BOARDS OF EDUCATION IMPLEMENT CERTAIN READING CURRICULUM MODELS OR PROGRAMS.
purpose: To make implementation of certain reading curriculum models or programs optional for boards of education.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. GARY A. TURCO, 27th DIST.; REP. AMY MORRIN BELLO, 28th DIST.
title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE FULL FUNDING OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION EXCESS COST GRANT.
purpose: To fully fund the special education excess cost grant.
introduced_by: REP. TURCO, 27th Dist.; REP. MORRIN BELLO, 28th Dist.

title: AN ACT LOWERING THE THRESHOLD FOR EXCESS COST REIMBURSEMENT FOR IN-DISTRICT SPECIAL EDUCATION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To lower the threshold for excess cost reimbursement for in-district special education programs from four and one-half times the net current expenditures per pupil to three times such expenditures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEACHER MEMBERSHIP ON THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To ensure that the perspective of practicing classroom teachers are included in the deliberations of the State Board of Education.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Ronald A. Napoli, 73rd Dist.; Rep. Greg S. Howard, 43rd Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY SCHOOL START TIMES.
purpose: To establish a task force to conduct a study on school start times.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEACHER CERTIFICATION RECIPROCITY.
purpose: To address the teacher shortage in the state by allowing qualified teachers from other states to obtain Connecticut certification more efficiently.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Greg S. Howard, 43rd Dist.

title: AN ACT PRIORITIZING SMALL TOWNS FOR EDUCATION FUNDING OPPORTUNITIES.
purpose: To prioritize towns with populations at or below twenty-five thousand for state education funding.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE AGE OF ELIGIBILITY FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION FOR A CHILD EXPERIENCING DEVELOPMENTAL DELAY.
purpose: To expand the age limit for eligibility for special education for a child experiencing developmental delay from age five to age nine.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BUTCHER SHOPS TO PROCESS FARMER-OWNED AND USDA INSPECTED LIVESTOCK.
purpose: To address the backlog for the processing of farmers' livestock.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN AUDIT OF THE EFFICACY OF INVESTIGATIONS AND ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS RELATED TO SUSPICIOUS DEATHS AND SERIOUS INJURIES THAT OCCUR ON THE WATERWAYS OF THE STATE.
purpose: To enhance boating safety and investigations of serious boating accidents that may have been attributable to operator impairment.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE NONAGRICULTURAL USE OF NEONICOTINOIDS.
purpose: To prohibit the nonagricultural use of neonicotinoids.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A LIMITED BLACK BEAR HUNTING SEASON.
purpose: To manage the black bear population in the state and protect residents.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING SENIOR CITIZENS, VETERANS AND ACTIVE DUTY MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE.
purpose: To exempt seniors, veterans and active duty members of the armed forces from the Passport to the Parks motor vehicle registration fee.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING SENIOR CITIZENS FROM FISHING LICENSE FEES.
purpose: To exempt senior citizens from fishing license fees.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COASTLINE RESILIENCY TO CLIMATE CHANGE.
purpose: To mitigate flooding and other damage caused by climate change in coastal areas of the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES PRICE THRESHOLD OF MOTOR VEHICLES SUBJECT TO A HIGHER SALES AND USE TAXES RATE.
purpose: To increase to more than one hundred thousand dollars the sales price threshold for a motor vehicle subject to the seven and three-fourths per cent sales and use taxes rate.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING TAX INCENTIVES TO ENCOURAGE SMALL AND MEDIUM-SIZED BUSINESSES TO HIRE LOCALLY.
purpose: To establish tax credits and wage subsidies to incentivize small and medium-sized businesses to participate in training programs and hire a significant portion of their workforce from the local community.
cosponsors: Sen. Herron Gaston, 23rd Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ELECTRONIC PORTAL FOR APPLICATIONS FOR STATE GRANT PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require the Secretary of the Office of Policy and Management to establish an electronic portal containing information a regarding state grant programs, including applications for such programs.
cosponsors: Rep. Christie M. Carpino, 32nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRACKING OF ABSENTEE BALLOTS.
purpose: To establish a secure, online and mobile-accessible system to allow electors who have returned absentee ballots to monitors such ballots progress toward being counted on the day of a primary or election.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GAMING ADVERTISEMENTS AND PERMISSIBLE PAYMENT MECHANISMS FOR ONLINE GAMING ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To provide that (1) a master wagering, online gaming operator, online gaming service provider or sports wagering retailer licensee shall obtain the permission of all account holders before authorizing any debit, charge or withdrawal on a jointly held debit card or credit card account, and (2) no advertising, marketing or other promotional materials published, aired, displayed or disseminated by or on behalf of any gaming entity licensee shall offer any financial incentive in order to induce individuals to engage in gaming.
cosponsors: Rep. David Rutigliano, 123rd Dist.; Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Tami Zawistowski, 61st Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING DIRECT-TO-CONSUMER PRESCRIPTION DRUG ADVERTISEMENTS.
purpose: To prohibit direct-to-consumer prescription drug advertisements directed at consumers in this state.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING GAMING-RELATED ADVERTISING, MARKETING AND PROMOTIONAL ACTIVITIES AT PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To prohibit gaming-related advertising, marketing and promotional activities at public institutions of higher education in this state.
cosponsors: Rep. David Rutigliano, 123rd Dist.; Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. William Heffernan, 115th Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN GAMING-RELATED ADVERTISING, MARKETING AND PROMOTIONAL ACTIVITIES.
purpose: To prohibit any gaming-related advertising, marketing or promotional activity that offers or provides any bonus, credit or other inducement to engage in or continue gaming.
cosponsors: Rep. David Rutigliano, 123rd Dist.; Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING PROPOSITION BETS INVOLVING CONNECTICUT INTERCOLLEGIATE TEAMS.
purpose: To prohibit any proposition bet that involves (1) any Connecticut intercollegiate team, (2) any coach of any Connecticut intercollegiate team, or (3) any athlete who is a member of any Connecticut intercollegiate team.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT LIMITING THE NUMBER OF STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION AUDITS.
purpose: To limit to five per cent the number of candidate committees to be audited by the State Elections Enforcement Commission after an election or primary.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT PREVENTING DECEPTIVE MARKETING BY PRIVATE CAREER SCHOOLS.
purpose: To regulate the advertising practices of private career schools to prevent deceptive marketing.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING DWELLING UNITS FOR PURCHASERS THAT MEET CERTAIN INCOME REQUIREMENTS IN THE CALCULATION OF THE THRESHOLD FOR THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCEDURE EXEMPTION.
purpose: To include dwelling units for purchasers that meet certain income requirements in the calculation of the ten per cent threshold for the affordable housing appeals procedure exemption.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING SPONSORING ASSOCIATIONS TO CREATE MULTIPLE EMPLOYER WELFARE ARRANGEMENTS.
purpose: To allow sponsoring associations to create multiple employer welfare arrangements for purposes of providing health insurance coverage to such sponsoring association's members.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH CARE INSURERS FROM RETROACTIVELY DENYING HEALTH INSURANCE CLAIMS FOR BEHAVIORAL HEALTH AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE SERVICES.
purpose: To limit health care insurers from retroactively denying health insurance claims and clawing back payments for behavioral health and substance abuse services: (1) After one year from the date of such service when prior authorization for such service was issued and the health care provider was paid for such service; and (2) when the health care insurer fails to provide written notice and an explanation of retroactive denial of the claim to the health care provider for such service within one year from the date of such service, except that health care insurers are exempt from such retroactive denial and clawback of claims limitations where any such heath insurance claim is based on fraudulent activity or such service was not delivered.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR INSULIN.
purpose: To prohibit any health carrier from (1) categorizing any insulin drug as a preferred or required drug for covered persons diagnosed with insulin-dependent diabetes or insulin-using diabetes, and (2) requiring review, appeal or approval of any such insulin drug prior to a medical provider prescribing such insulin drug to such covered person.

primary_sponsors: REP. GARY A. TURCO, 27th DIST.; REP. MIKE DEMICCO, 21st DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER PROTECTIONS FOR LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE.
purpose: To establish certain consumer protections for long-term care insurance.
cosponsors: Rep. Kate Farrar, 20th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. TURCO, 27th Dist.; REP. DEMICCO, 21st Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING INSURANCE COMPANIES FROM USING CREDIT HISTORY AS A FACTOR IN UNDERWRITING OR RATING HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To prohibit insurance companies from using an applicant's or insured's credit history as a factor in underwriting or rating homeowners insurance policies.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide coverage for emergency medical services, regardless of whether the covered person is transported when medically necessary by ambulance to a hospital.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TERMINOLOGY USED IN THE CONNECTICUT PARENTAGE ACT.
purpose: To protect the rights of women by requiring the use of the word "mother" in the Connecticut Parentage Act.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT INCREASING PENALTIES FOR CERTAIN VEHICULAR CRIMES.
purpose: To decrease the incidents of dangerous and reckless driving on state roads.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRONIC STALKING.
purpose: To better protect victims of electronic stalking.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THREATS MADE TO SCHOOLS.
purpose: To discourage and punish the reporting of false threats to school systems.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPARENCY AND SUPPORT SYSTEMS FOR UNDOCUMENTED INDIVIDUALS IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To enhance transparency, data collection and coordination between Connecticut's justice and mental health systems to support undocumented individuals, while ensuring privacy and compliance with legal frameworks and to enable informed policymaking to address specific needs and challenges faced by undocumented residents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PREVAILING WAGE THRESHOLDS.
purpose: To increase the total cost threshold for certain public works projects and require such threshold to be indexed annually to reflect the rate of inflation.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONEXEMPT EMPLOYEES OF THE DIVISION OF CRIMINAL JUSTICE.
purpose: To allow nonexempt employees of the Division of Criminal Justice to be employed as adjunct professors.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEMS IN HISTORIC DISTRICTS.
purpose: To prohibit a historic district commission from declining to issue certificate of appropriateness based on the proposed installation of a solar energy system if such system is to be installed on a rear-facing roof of a structure.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A TWO-THIRDS VOTE OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY TO CREATE OR EXPAND UNFUNDED MANDATES TO MUNICIPALITIES AND SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To require a two-thirds vote of each chamber of the General Assembly to enact legislation to create or expand an unfunded mandate to a municipality or school district.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUSTAINABLE ZONING PRACTICES.
purpose: To encourage the development of natural infrastructure projects, sustainable zoning practices and resiliency measures.
cosponsors: Rep. Nicholas Menapace, 37th Dist.

title: AN ACT STREAMLINING THE CERTIFICATE OF NEED PROCESS.
purpose: To improve the delivery of care to patients by reducing the delay caused by the certificate of need application and approval process.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ASSISTED LIVING FACILITIES TO HAVE AN AUTOMATED EXTERNAL DEFIBRILLATOR AVAILABLE IN A PUBLIC AREA.
purpose: To require the availability of an automated external defibrillator in a public area of each assisted living facility.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPARENCY IN VETERINARY NEGLIGENCE INVESTIGATIONS.
purpose: To require transparency and accountability in investigations of veterinary negligence by ensuring that the owner of an animal that is the subject of an allegation of such negligence is informed about the status and outcome of the investigation.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE ADOPTION OF THE UNITED STATES FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION'S FOOD CODE.
purpose: To repeal the adoption of the United States Food and Drug Administration's Food Code.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY FAMILY WELL-BEING AND TACKLE HEALTH, ECONOMIC AND ENVIRONMENTAL CHALLENGES FACING OVERBURDENED AND UNDER-RESOURCED COMMUNITIES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To establish a task force to study family well-being and address health, economic and environmental challenges facing overburdened and under-resourced communities in the state.
cosponsors: Sen. Herron Gaston, 23rd Dist.; Rep. Christopher Rosario, 128th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH TO LICENSE DRAMA THERAPISTS AND DANCE/MOVEMENT THERAPISTS.
purpose: To require licensure of drama therapists and dance/movement therapists.

primary_sponsors: REP. LEZLYE ZUPKUS, 89th DIST.; SEN. CATHERINE A. OSTEN, 19th DIST.
title: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE CIVIL AIR PATROL FROM CERTAIN LICENSURE REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To enable the civil air patrol to operate seasonal encampments for cadets without being licensed under chapter 368r of the general statutes.
cosponsors: Rep. Joseph P. Gresko, 121st Dist.; Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Dave W. Yaccarino, 87th Dist.; Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. ZUPKUS, 89th Dist.; SEN. OSTEN, 19th Dist.

title: AN ACT REDEFINING "FIRE DEPARTMENT" TO SPECIFICALLY INCLUDE FIRE MARSHALS.
purpose: To redefine "fire department" to specify that municipal fire marshals shall not be liable for smoke or carbon monoxide detector installation.
cosponsors: Rep. Ben McGorty, 122nd Dist.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY TO LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for law enforcement officers regarding proper actions in the field.

primary_sponsors: REP. GARY A. TURCO, 27th DIST.; REP. AMY MORRIN BELLO, 28th DIST.
title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR RECKLESS DRIVING.
purpose: To increase the penalty for reckless driving and deter dangerous behavior.
cosponsors: Sen. Joan V. Hartley, 15th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. TURCO, 27th Dist.; REP. MORRIN BELLO, 28th Dist.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING THE LAND ON WHICH A DWELLING SITS IN THE PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION FOR VETERANS WITH A SERVICE-CONNECTED PERMANENT AND TOTAL DISABILITY RATING.
purpose: To include the land on which a dwelling sits, in addition to the dwelling itself, in a certain veterans property tax exemption.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. REBECCA MARTINEZ, 22nd DIST.; SEN. HENRI MARTIN, 31st DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECT AT THE MIDDLE SCHOOL OF PLAINVILLE.
purpose: To provide an exemption from the state standard space specifications requirements for the school building project at Middle School of Plainville in the town of Plainville.
introduced_by: REP. MARTINEZ, 22nd Dist.; SEN. MARTIN, 31st Dist.

title: AN ACT LIMITING LOCAL PROPERTY TAX INCREASES ON SENIORS AND CERTAIN PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To reduce the incidences of local property tax increases harming elderly and disabled residents on fixed incomes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE FACILITY EMPLOYEE AND VOLUNTEER BACKGROUND CHECKS.
purpose: To prevent elder abuse by requiring all prospective employees and volunteers of long-term care facilities to submit to background checks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT MARCHING BAND UNIFORMS.
purpose: To provide funding for The University of Connecticut to purchase new uniforms for the first time in fifteen years for its marching band members.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PARTIAL MORTGAGE PAYMENTS.
purpose: To provide that mortgage lenders and mortgage servicers shall accept and apply any partial mortgage payment made by a mortgagor.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A PILOT PROGRAM FOR AT-RISK YOUTH.
purpose: To establish a pilot program for at-risk youth in grades seven to nine, inclusive, to engage in hands-on, project-based learning programs that align academic content with practical applications, including vocational and community experience.
cosponsors: Rep. Kevin Brown, 56th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUPPORT FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To provide adequate support for in-district special education placements and for state special education mandates and best practices.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A WEB-BASED MENTAL HEALTH PLATFORM FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To assist children and students in accessing mental health services.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT A SCHOOL DISTRICT MAY REDUCE ITS MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENT WHEN IT EXPERIENCES A DECLINE IN STUDENT ENROLLMENT.
purpose: To provide mandate relief by allowing school districts greater authority to reduce their education budgets when there is reduced student enrollment.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND OF THE PRESS FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To protect student expression and student publications except when such expression or publications are obscene, libelous, slanderous or disrupt school activities.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING SCHOOL DISTRICTS TO OPT OUT OF THE COMMON CORE STATE STANDARDS.
purpose: To allow school districts to opt out of the Common Core State Standards and to choose an alternative standard for its curriculum.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. KAREN REDDINGTON-HUGHES, 66th DIST.; REP. MARK W ANDERSON, 62nd DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION AND CONTROL OF THE BLACK BEAR POPULATION IN THE STATE.
purpose: To establish a bear management framework intended to ensure a healthy bear population, minimize conflicts between bears and humans and allow for limited regulated hunting of black bear.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.
introduced_by: REP. REDDINGTON -HUGHES, 66th Dist.; REP. ANDERSON, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING LOCAL BUTCHER SHOPS TO PROCESS FARMER-OWNED USDA AND INSPECTED MEAT PRODUCTS.
purpose: To alleviate livestock processing backlogs in the state.

title: AN ACT LIMITING THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE TO ONE VEHICLE PER HOUSEHOLD.
purpose: To provide savings to the registrants of vehicles by limiting the assessment of the Passport to the Parks Fee to one vehicle per household.

primary_sponsors: REP. DEVIN R. CARNEY, 23rd DIST.; REP. TAMI ZAWISTOWSKI, 61st DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISCHARGE OF CONTAMINATED WATER INTO THE CONNECTICUT RIVER BY MASSACHUSETTS-BASED ENTITIES.
purpose: To stop the state of Massachusetts from allowing the discharge of pollutants into the Connecticut River.
introduced_by: REP. CARNEY, 23rd Dist.; REP. ZAWISTOWSKI, 61st Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING QUALIFIED RENEWABLE DIESEL PRODUCER GRANTS.
purpose: To provide grant funding for qualified renewable diesel producers.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELECTION OF STATE'S ATTORNEYS.
purpose: To provide for the election of a state's attorney in each of the judicial districts.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SINGLE HIRING RATIO FOR THE SKILLED TRADES.
purpose: To provide that the hiring ratio for the skilled trades shall be one apprentice to one licensee.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING A SKILLED-TRADE LICENSING EXEMPTION FOR FEDERAL, STATE AND MUNICIPAL AGENCY EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To eliminate a provision exempting federal, state and municipal agency employees from certain licensing requirements concerning skilled tradespersons.
cosponsors: Rep. Tim Ackert, 8th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SINGLE SKILLED-TRADE HIRING RATIO.
purpose: To establish a single skilled-trade hiring ratio of one apprentice to one licensee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DIVERTING A PORTION OF SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE BENEFITS FOR DRUG COUNSELING FOR BENEFICIARIES CONVICTED OF COMMITTING A DRUG-RELATED FELONY.
purpose: To provide drug counseling to those who are convicted of committing a drug-related felony while receiving state-administered supplemental nutrition assistance program benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INDEXING MEDICAID PAYMENT RATES TO THE RATE OF INFLATION.
purpose: To keep Medicaid reimbursement rates consistent with the rise in costs and wages in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR RECONSTRUCTIVE SURGERY FOLLOWING MELANOMA SURGERY ON THE FACE.
purpose: To require that individual and group health insurance policies provide health insurance coverage for reconstructive surgery following melanoma surgery on the face, including surgical procedures necessary to correct disfigurement, restore normal symmetry and correct functional impairments resulting from such melanoma surgery.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE.
purpose: To: (1) Prohibit any long-term care insurer from requesting a premium rate increase that exceeds the most recent calendar year average in the consumer price index for urban consumers, as published by the United States Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics, which shall apply to renewed long-term care policies that were initially purchased by policyholders not less than fifteen years ago; (2) prohibit any long-term care insurer from requesting a premium rate increase of five per cent or more; and (3) require any long-term care insurer that files premium rate increase requests of twenty per cent or more for long-term care insurance policies to spread such increases over not less than five years.
cosponsors: Rep. Hubert D. Delany, 144th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UMBRELLA LIABILITY COVERAGE FOR PUBLIC OFFICIALS.
purpose: To provide that insurance carriers shall provide liability coverage, including general liability and automobile liability coverage, that is supplemental to an underlying liability policy for elected public officials.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MINIMUM AGE TO ARREST A CHILD.
purpose: To raise the minimum age to arrest a child to fourteen years of age.
cosponsors: Rep. Laurie Sweet, 91st Dist.; Sen. Norman Needleman, 33rd Dist.; Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING MINIMUM WAGE COMPENSATION FOR ALL JURORS.
purpose: To require the state minimum wage be paid for jury service to ensure equity and fairness in the jury system.

title: AN ACT REDUCING FILING FEES INCURRED BY CERTAIN BUSINESS ENTITIES FOR FILING ANNUAL REPORTS WITH THE OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE.
purpose: To reduce the filing fee for annual reports filed by limited partnerships, limited liability companies and limited liability partnerships from eighty dollars to twenty dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF THE UNIFORM REAL PROPERTY TRANSFER ON DEATH ACT.
purpose: To adopt the Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE ELDER JUSTICE DIVISION WITHIN THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF STATE'S ATTORNEY.
purpose: To establish an elder justice division within the Office of the Chief State's Attorney.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING MARRIAGE BETWEEN FIRST COUSINS.
purpose: To prohibit marriage between first cousins.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF A PARENTS' RIGHT TO RAISE THEIR CHILDREN CONSISTENT WITH THEIR CHILDREN'S BIOLOGICAL SEX AND THE PROMOTION OF FAIRNESS IN INTERSCHOLASTIC ATHLETIC COMPETITION.
purpose: To protect a parents' right to raise children consistent with their biological sex and promote fairness in interscholastic athletic competition.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PATIENT ACCESS TO MEDICAL RECORDS.
purpose: To ensure patients have affordable access to their own medical records.

primary_sponsors: REP. MITCH BOLINSKY, 106th DIST.; REP. AMY MORRIN BELLO, 28th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE LICENSURE OF DANCE/MOVEMENT THERAPISTS.
purpose: To require the licensure of dance/movement therapists in the state.
introduced_by: REP. BOLINSKY, 106th Dist.; REP. MORRIN BELLO, 28th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. HENRY J. GENGA, 10th DIST.; SEN. SAUD ANWAR, 3rd DIST.; SEN. JEFF GORDON, 35th DIST.; REP. WILLIAM HEFFERNAN, 115th DIST.; REP. ANTHONY L. NOLAN, 39th DIST.; SEN. CATHERINE A. OSTEN, 19th DIST.
title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CENTER OF EXCELLENCE FOR NEUROMODULATION TREATMENTS FOR VETERANS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT IN COLLABORATION WITH HARTFORD HEALTHCARE PHYSICAL MEDICINE AND REHABILITATION.
purpose: To establish and provide funding for a Center of Excellence for Neuromodulation Treatments for Veterans at The University of Connecticut in Collaboration with Hartford HealthCare Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.
introduced_by: REP. GENGA, 10th Dist.; SEN. ANWAR, 3rd Dist.; SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.; REP. HEFFERNAN, 115th Dist.; REP. NOLAN, 39th Dist.; SEN. OSTEN, 19th Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE STATE FROM MANDATING A COVID-19 VACCINATION.
purpose: To prohibit the state, or any employee thereof, from mandating a COVID-19 vaccination.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

purpose: To (1) remove the "Combined Public Benefits Charge" from consumer electric bills, (2) prohibit the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection or electric distribution companies from entering into a power purchase agreement if the price for electricity under such agreement exceeds one hundred fifty per cent above the wholesale price of electricity, (3) redefine "Class I renewable energy source" to include electricity generated from any hydropower or nuclear power generating facility, (4) separate the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority from the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection, (5) eliminate any incentive program that increases electric demand, including, but not limited to, any electric vehicle rebate program, and (6) study methods by which the supply of natural gas may be increased in the state.

primary_sponsors: REP. MOIRA RADER, 98th DIST.; SEN. CHRISTINE COHEN, 12th DIST.

purpose: To allow educators who are rated as exemplary or proficient to continue to use their teaching hours focused on classroom instruction and student development by not requiring annual evaluations for such high-achieving educators, and providing educators with continuing support who have not yet reached exemplary and proficient evaluation ratings.

cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

purpose: To require the establishment of a grant program to assist schools, with a priority given to priority schools, with implementing cardiac emergency response plans and a procedure for monitoring adherence to cardiac emergency response plans and to allow local and regional boards of education to accept gifts, grants and donations for such purpose.

purpose: To revise the education cost sharing grant formula by increasing the foundation amount and adding a provision that adjusts such foundation amount for inflation.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING STATE-WIDE START TIMES FOR PUBLIC MIDDLE AND HIGH SCHOOLS.
purpose: To establish a state-wide later start time for public middle schools and high schools.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE CULTIVATION OF OCTOPUS FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION AND THE USE OF OCTOPUS FOR ENTERTAINMENT PURPOSES.
purpose: To prohibit the farming of octopus for human consumption and the use of octopus for entertainment purposes.
cosponsors: Rep. Nicholas Menapace, 37th Dist.

purpose: To discontinue charging the Passport to the Parks fee to each vehicle owned by a person and replace such structure with a fee assessed to each residence.
cosponsors: Rep. Christopher Poulos, 81st Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE APPLICATION OF PESTICIDES TO ORGANIC FOODS.
purpose: To prohibit the application of pesticides to organic foods.

purpose: To study the care provided to pets sold in pet stores in the state.

purpose: To exempt senior citizens and veterans from the Passport to the Parks vehicle registration fee and to apply such vehicle registration fee to only one vehicle when a person registers more than one vehicle with the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF FIREARMS FITTED WITH SOUND SUPPRESSORS BY HUNTERS.
purpose: To authorize the use of gun sound suppressors by hunters.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE REGULATION OF PESTICIDE USE BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To preempt municipalities from regulating the use of pesticides and leaving such regulation to the state and federal governments.

purpose: To repeal the single-use plastic bag ban and prohibit the use of PFAS in paper straws.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

purpose: To establish an extended producer responsibility program for wind turbine blades and solar panels.

purpose: To protect the health and safety of visitors to state parks and beaches.

purpose: To provide that no private contractor shall, for compensation, remove any snow or ice by using sodium chloride unless such contractor (1) is registered with the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection, and (2) has received training regarding the proper use of sodium chloride for purposes of snow and ice removal.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE CONNECTICUT GREEN BANK AND INCENTIVES FOR SOLAR INSTALLATIONS FOR CERTAIN COMMUNITIES AND HOUSEHOLDS.
purpose: To (1) expand funding for the Connecticut Green Bank, (2) support income-based incentives for solar photovoltaic system installations for low and moderated income households, (3) provide tax credits for the installation of solar photovoltaic systems in economically distressed communities and environmental justice communities, (4) support community solar programs, (5) ensure net metering provides a fair economic benefit to end use electric customers utilizing such metering, (6) incentivize solar installation workforce expansion, (7) improve the electric distribution grid in underserved areas, and (8) provide for targeted incentives to increase the adoption of solar photovoltaic systems in underserved communities.
cosponsors: Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. HUGHES, 135th Dist.; REP. SWEET, 91st Dist.; REP. MENAPACE, 37th Dist.; REP. SHANNON, 117th Dist.; REP. DEMICCO, 21st Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENTS BASED ON WHOLESALE PRICES AND REQUIRING JOINT SOLICITATIONS FOR CERTAIN CLEAN ENERGY PROJECTS.
purpose: To (1) prohibit the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection or any electric distribution company from entering into a power purchase agreement that provides for the purchase of electricity at a rate exceeding one hundred fifty per cent above the wholesale price of electricity, and (2) require the commissioner to solicit any clean energy project with a capacity exceeding twenty megawatts with two or more other states.

primary_sponsors: REP. BRIAN LANOUE, 45th DIST.; REP. DOUG DUBITSKY, 47th DIST.
title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPANY ACCOUNTABILITY AND ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPETITION AND INFRASTRUCTURE.
purpose: To establish a task force to (1) study electric distribution companies and such companies' accountability and responsiveness to ratepayers, (2) study the introduction of competition in the electric transmission or distribution services industry in Connecticut, and (3) provide an evaluation concerning the costs of acquiring electric transmission or distribution services infrastructure from each electric distribution company and recommendations regarding whether acquisitions are necessary to maintain electric grid reliability in the state.
introduced_by: REP. LANOUE, 45th Dist.; REP. DUBITSKY, 47th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. ANNE M. HUGHES, 135th DIST.; REP. KENNETH GUCKER, 138th DIST.
title: AN ACT IMPOSING AN EXCISE TAX ON PRIVATE UTILITY COMPANIES.
purpose: To (1) impose an excise tax upon any private utility company for the purpose of funding energy assistance programs in the state and reducing the Combined Public Benefits Charge on end use customer utility bills, and (2) require that each public utility report the impact of such excise tax in the Combined Public Benefits Charge section of any utility bill sent to an end use customer of such utility.
introduced_by: REP. HUGHES, 135th Dist.; REP. GUCKER, 138th Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE CLEARING OF FOREST LAND FOR GRID-SCALE SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC PROJECTS.
purpose: To (1) prohibit the clearing of such land for the purpose of developing grid-scale solar photovoltaic projects, and (2) encourage the siting of such projects on canopies, roofs, brownfields or on existing developed land uses.
cosponsors: Rep. Laurie Sweet, 91st Dist.; Sen. Jorge Cabrera, 17th Dist.; Rep. Michael "MJ" Shannon, 117th Dist.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING A SURCHARGE ON ELECTRICITY CONSUMED BY DATA CENTERS.
purpose: To (1) create a surcharge on electricity consumed by data centers in the state, and (2) use the proceeds of such surcharge to pay the Combined Public Benefits Charge reflected on electric utility bills for end use residential customers.

primary_sponsors: REP. STEVEN WINTER, 94th DIST.; REP. MARY M. MUSHINSKY, 85th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCENTIVES FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF RESIDENTIAL ELECTRIC RESISTANCE HEATING SYSTEMS.
purpose: To increase the rate of replacement of residential electric resistance heating systems by (1) identifying dwelling units that would benefit from such replacement, and (2) requiring additional marketing and incentives for the replacement of such systems.
introduced_by: REP. WINTER, 94th Dist.; REP. MUSHINSKY, 85th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL APPROVAL FOR CERTAIN GRID SCALE NONRESIDENTIAL SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC FACILITIES.
purpose: To allow any municipality with two or more existing nonresidential solar photovoltaic facilities located within such municipality to (1) approve or reject subsequent nonresidential solar photovoltaic facilities proposed for construction or installation in such municipality, and (2) impose a moratorium on the construction or installation of such facilities within such municipality.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY TO MAKE MORE FREQUENT RATE ADJUSTMENTS.
purpose: To require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to make more frequent utility rate adjustments.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE CONNECTICUT HOME ENERGY LABEL AND CREATING A TRAINING PROGRAM FOR ENERGY-EFFICIENCY PROFESSIONALS.
purpose: To (1) require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to develop a label that provides a score regarding a residence's energy efficiency, and (2) create a training program for professionals who evaluate energy efficiency in the state.

title: AN ACT REMOVING THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFIT CHARGE FROM UTILITY BILLS, AMENDING THE DEFINITION OF CLASS I RENEWABLE ENERGY SOURCES, LIMITING RATES ALLOWED UNDER CERTAIN POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENTS AND REMOVING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To (1) remove the "Combined Public Benefits Charge" from consumer electric bills, (2) redefine "Class I renewable energy source" to include electricity generated from any hydropower or nuclear power generating facility, (3) prohibit the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection or electric distribution companies from entering into a power purchase agreement if the price for electricity under such agreement exceeds one hundred fifty per cent above the wholesale price of electricity, and (4) remove the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority from the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR INDIVIDUAL COMPONENTS OF THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE.
purpose: To repeal any component of the Combined Public Benefits Charge not approved by the General Assembly and require future charges be approved by the General Assembly.

primary_sponsors: REP. MARY M. MUSHINSKY, 85th DIST.; REP. STEVEN WINTER, 94th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INSTALLATION OF ADVANCED CONDUCTORS IN NEW OR EXISTING TRANSMISSION LINES.
purpose: To require that electric distribution companies install advanced conductors with an efficiency rating not less than fifteen per cent higher than steel core conductors in any new or existing transmission line.
cosponsors: Rep. Joseph P. Gresko, 121st Dist.
introduced_by: REP. MUSHINSKY, 85th Dist.; REP. WINTER, 94th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. MICHAEL "MJ" SHANNON, 117th DIST.; REP. STEVEN WINTER, 94th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCENTIVES FOR THE ADOPTION OF HEAT PUMP WATER HEATERS.
purpose: To establish a program to incentivize the replacement of electric resistance water heaters with heat pump water heaters.
introduced_by: REP. SHANNON, 117th Dist.; REP. WINTER, 94th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. GEOFF LUXENBERG, 12th DIST.; REP. LIZ LINEHAN, 103rd DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ACQUISITION OF AN ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPANY BY THE STATE.
purpose: To (1) create a committee to determine the value of an electric distribution company currently providing service in the state and the states of Massachusetts and New Hampshire, (2) empower the State Bond Commission to authorize the issuance of bonds of the state in accordance with section 3-20 of the general statutes, the proceeds of which shall be used to acquire such company by the state, and (3) empower said committee to sell any asset of such company located outside the state for the purpose of recovering financial expenditures in connection with the acquisition of such company.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.; Sen. MD Rahman, 4th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. LUXENBERG, 12th Dist.; REP. LINEHAN, 103rd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BILLING FOR ELECTRICITY AT CUSTOMERS' FORMER PREMISES.
purpose: To prevent former building owners and tenants from being billed for electric service they do not use because they sold or moved out of the property.

purpose: To remove charges collectively called the "Combined Public Benefits Charge" from electric bills and require that any such future charge be implemented only upon the affirmative vote of the General Assembly.

purpose: To require the owner of any nonresidential grid-scale battery storage system to certify that each component of such system has been procured from a source that does not utilize slave or child labor.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REPEAL OF THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE AND REQUIRING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR ANY FUTURE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE.
purpose: To remove charges collectively called the "Combined Public Benefits Charge" from electric bills and require that any such future charge be implemented only upon the affirmative vote of the General Assembly.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. STEVEN WINTER, 94th DIST.; REP. MARY M. MUSHINSKY, 85th DIST.

purpose: To fund the Residential Energy Preparation Services program.
introduced_by: REP. WINTER, 94th Dist.; REP. MUSHINSKY, 85th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTICE OF EXCAVATION BY A PUBLIC UTILITY TO AFFECTED PROPERTY OWNERS.
purpose: To require a public utility to provide notice to affected property owners prior to engaging in excavation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PURCHASE OF ENERGY CREDITS FROM OUT-OF-STATE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To allow electric suppliers to purchase renewable energy credits from out-of-state providers.

title: AN ACT REMOVING THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE FROM ELECTRIC UTILITY BILLS AND REQUIRING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR ANY FUTURE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE.
purpose: To remove charges collectively called the "Combined Public Benefits Charge" from electric bills and require that any such future charge be implemented only upon the affirmative vote of the General Assembly.

purpose: To (1) require the Connecticut Siting Council to consider the plan of conservation and development adopted by a municipality in which a commercial grid-scale solar photovoltaic system is proposed for development prior to approving any such development, (2) limit the land area in any municipality that may be used for commercial grid-scale solar photovoltaic system development to one-half of one per cent, (3) allow a local zoning authority to adopt minimum setback requirements for any commercial grid-scale solar photovoltaic system, (4) expand the jurisdiction of the Connecticut Siting Council to any commercial grid-scale solar photovoltaic system regardless of such system's generation capacity, and (5) require said council to work in collaboration with local zoning authorities prior to approving the development of any commercial grid-scale solar photovoltaic system in a municipality.

purpose: To require each public utility company to create a public facing dashboard for the purpose of increasing transparency and accountability in the provision of utility services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROGRAM FOR INCREASED ADOPTION OF HEAT PUMP WATER HEATERS.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to establish a program to increase the rate at which electrical resistance water heaters are replaced with heat pump water heaters.
cosponsors: Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.
