title: AN ACT CONCERNING CABLE TELEVISION SERVICE.
purpose: To (1) allow cable television subscribers to choose the programming included in their subscription, and (2) require increased transparency concerning each component of any consumer bill for cable television services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPOINTMENT OF A CONSUMER PROTECTION ADVOCATE TO THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY.
purpose: To require that not fewer than one member of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority have experience in consumer protection and advocacy and that such member be appointed for the purpose of protecting consumers and ratepayers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REGIONAL WATER AUTHORITIES ESTABLISHED BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To allow a municipality to establish a regional water authority.
cosponsors: Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF THE NATURAL GAS SUPPLY IN THE STATE AND REMOVING ELECTRIC VEHICLE INCENTIVES FROM THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE.
purpose: To (1) require the expansion of the natural gas supply in the state, and (2) remove any cost associated with any program that provides incentives for electric vehicles from the Combined Public Benefits Charge.
cosponsors: Rep. Christopher Poulos, 81st Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. JAIME S. FOSTER, 57th DIST.; REP. RONALD A. NAPOLI, 73rd DIST.; REP. CHRISTOPHER POULOS, 81st DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY FROM EMPLOYMENT WITH UTILITY COMPANIES FOR A PERIOD OF FIFTEEN YEARS.
purpose: To prohibit any member of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority from employment with a utility company for a period of fifteen years after the term of such member ends.
introduced_by: REP. FOSTER, 57th Dist.; REP. NAPOLI, 73rd Dist.; REP. POULOS, 81st Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENT ARRANGEMENTS FOR ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPANY CUSTOMERS.
purpose: To require an electric distribution company to provide payment arrangements or budget billing agreements to cover any outstanding balance owed by an end use customer of such company, including balances owed for the Combined Public Benefits Charge.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN IMPACT EVALUATION CONCERNING LARGE DATA CENTERS.
purpose: To require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to evaluate the impact of large data centers on grid reliability.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE.
purpose: To repeal any component of the Combined Public Benefits Charge not approved by the General Assembly and require future charges be approved by the General Assembly.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE, THE RESTORATION OF ELECTRICITY SERVICE AFTER SYSTEM SERVICE OUTAGES, PROMOTING THE USAGE OF SMART METERS AND PROHIBITING TAX ASSESSMENT INCREASES BASED ON RESIDENTIAL SOLAR INSTALLATIONS.
purpose: To (1) require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to conduct a ratepayer impact review concerning the charges collectively called the "Combined Public Benefits Charge" on electric bills for end use customers of each electric distribution company, (2) require said authority to review whether the ninety-six-consecutive-hour standard in subsection (b) of section 16-32l of the general statutes imposes undue costs and whether such standard should be revised, (3) promote an increase in electricity generation through shared subscription solar or battery storage projects, (4) encourage the adoption of smart meter systems for ratepayers, (5) create a tax credit for ratepayers who have paid the Combined Public Benefits Charge, (6) prohibit municipal tax assessors from increasing the assessed value of any residential property based on the installation or use of a solar photovoltaic system at such property, (7) require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to conduct more frequent reviews of costs to ratepayers for storm damage remediation, and (8) require the reinvestment of certain funds paid to a nuclear power plant operation pursuant to power purchase agreements entered into or approved by the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection.
cosponsors: Rep. Christopher Poulos, 81st Dist.; Rep. Lucy Dathan, 142nd Dist.; Rep. Savet Constantine, 42nd Dist.; Rep. Farley Santos, 109th Dist.; Rep. Hector Arzeno, 151st Dist.; Rep. Jill Barry, 31st Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCREASING THE SUPPLY OF NATURAL GAS AND HYDROGEN POWER IN THE NEW ENGLAND REGION.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to collaborate with the New England states to increase the supply of natural gas and hydrogen in the region.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY TO REGULATE RESIDENTIAL INTERNET SERVICE.
purpose: To require the regulation of all residential Internet service as a public utility in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPTING OUT OF SMART METER PROGRAMS.
purpose: To allow any residential electric end use customer to opt out of any program or regulation that would require the installation of a smart meter.
cosponsors: Rep. Doug Dubitsky, 47th Dist.

purpose: To exempt from the sales tax items purchased by disabled individuals from Internet marketplace facilitators.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING HOSPITAL BEDS FOR HOME HEALTH CARE USE FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt from the sales and use taxes the sale of and the storage, use or other consumption in this state of hospital beds for home health care use.
cosponsors: Rep. James Sanchez, 6th Dist.; Rep. Jill Barry, 31st Dist.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

purpose: To exempt handicap ramps for residential use from the sales and use taxes.

purpose: To require a percentage of the revenue generated from the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store to be used for certain purposes.

purpose: To require that individual and group health insurance policies provide health insurance coverage for facial reconstructive surgery following treatment for skin cancer on the face, including, but not limited to, melanoma.
cosponsors: Sen. Herron Gaston, 23rd Dist.
introduced_by: REP. PAOLILLO A., 97th Dist.; SEN. LOONEY, 11th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR OUT-OF-NETWORK GROUND TRANSPORT AMBULANCE CHARGES.
purpose: To regulate health insurance coverage concerns not addressed by the federal No Surprises Act, 26 USC 9816, as amended from time to time, to ensure that individuals in this state do not receive surprise out-of-network ground transport ambulance charges for which health carriers are not obligated to provide coverage.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE FEASIBILITY OF ESTABLISHING A CAPTIVE INSURANCE COMPANY TO PROVIDE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO FARMERS IMPACTED BY THE EFFECTS OF SEVERE WEATHER.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Commissioner, in consultation with the Commissioner of Agriculture, conduct a feasibility study for establishing a captive insurance company to provide financial assistance to farmers in the state impacted by the effects of severe weather.
cosponsors: Sen. MD Rahman, 4th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT RESALE CERTIFICATES APPLY TO CERTAIN COMMON INTEREST COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To require that the provisions of the Common Interest Ownership Act concerning resale certificates apply to common interest communities created in this state before January 1, 1984.

purpose: To: (1) Require each health carrier to submit an annual certification regarding compliance with applicable state and federal parity laws for mental health and substance use disorder benefits; (2) repeal state law provisions mandating confidential treatment of the names and identities of health carriers on annual nonquantitative treatment limitations filings; (3) establish a parity advancement account within the General Fund to fund initiatives supporting enforcement and consumer education; and (4) authorize the Insurance Commissioner to assess civil penalties for violations of parity laws by health carriers.

title: AN ACT REGULATING ACCESSIBILITY AND COSTS OF HEALTH CARE IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To: (1) Increase Medicaid reimbursement rates; (2) regulate medical debt; (3) regulate pharmacy benefits management practices; (4) conduct a study of, and provide consumers access to, the impact of vertical integration in the health care system in this state; (5) limit the use of prior authorization practices; and (6) regulate private equity acquisition of hospitals and medical care centers.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne M. Hughes, 135th Dist.; Rep. Michael "MJ" Shannon, 117th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COVERAGE FOR MEDICALLY NECESSARY TREATMENT IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To: (1) Require any health carrier to align coverage guidelines with the most recent evidence-based medical standards; (2) require transparency in health carriers' claim-review practices; (3) require coverage for medical treatments for life-saving care that are recommended by licensed health care provider specialists, unless medical evidence justifies denial of such coverage; (4) revise the process for review of adverse determinations to require (A) review of nonurgent care requests to be resolved within ten business days, and (B) review of urgent care requests to be resolved within forty-eight hours.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING NONPROFITS TO PARTICIPATE IN ASSOCIATION HEALTH PLANS.
purpose: To allow nonprofits to participate in association health plans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CREDIT CARD SKIMMING.
purpose: To protect consumers from identity theft associated with credit card skimming.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CASTLE DOCTRINE.
purpose: To fully adopt the Castle Doctrine.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF THE STAND-YOUR-GROUND LAW.
purpose: To adopt stand-your-ground as law and remove the duty to retreat.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE ADDRESS CONFIDENTIALITY PROGRAM TO INCLUDE REAL PROPERTY AND PROPERTY TAX RECORDS.
purpose: To expand the existing address confidentiality program for victims of certain enumerated crimes such as family violence to shield real property and property tax records containing such victim's name from disclosure.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ANIMAL ABUSE.
purpose: To increase the penalty for a first offense of starvation of, violence against or death of an animal and performing medical procedures or experimentation without a veterinarian license.
cosponsors: Rep. Cara Christine Pavalock-D'Amato, 77th Dist.; Rep. Christopher Poulos, 81st Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF "PARENTING TIME" IN THE GENERAL STATUTES.
purpose: To amend the general statutes to utilize "parenting time" instead of "custody" or "visitation" when describing time spent between a child and parent.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING INCARCERATED PERSONS TO BE DEBT-FREE UPON RELEASE.
purpose: To allow a formerly incarcerated person an easier reentry into society.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAUSE OF ACTION FOR TORTIOUS INTERFERENCE WITH AN EXPECTED INHERITANCE.
purpose: To establish a civil cause of action for tortious interference with an expected inheritance.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE APPOINTMENT OF COUNSEL BY THE OFFICE OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL OR ANY OTHER STATE AGENCY FOR UNDOCUMENTED IMMIGRANTS DURING DEPORTATION PROCEEDINGS.
purpose: To prohibit the appointment of counsel by the Office of the Attorney General or any other state agency for undocumented immigrants during deportation proceedings.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ASSERTION OF A SPECIAL DEFENSE AGAINST A CLAIM OF NONPAYMENT OF A COMMON EXPENSE ASSESSMENT.
purpose: To permit condominium unit owners to assert a special defense against a claim of nonpayment of a common interest assessment under certain circumstances.

title: AN ACT LOWERING THE FEES CHARGED BY THE OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE FOR OBTAINING AN APOSTILLE.
purpose: To reduce the cost of obtaining an apostille in the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAUSE OF ACTION AGAINST A PERSON FOR CREATING A NUISANCE DUE TO THE SMOKE FROM OR ODOR OF CANNABIS.
purpose: To establish a cause of action against a person for a nuisance caused by the smoke from or odor of cannabis that results in interference with the use of one's property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMPOSITION AND OPERATIONAL PROCEDURES OF THE JUDICIAL SELECTION COMMISSION.
purpose: To revise statutory provisions concerning: (1) The composition of the Judicial Selection Commission; and (2) certain internal operational procedures concerning decisions issued by said commission.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING SPEEDY EVICTION PROCEEDINGS FOR THE REMOVAL OF SQUATTERS.
purpose: To establish an expedited process for the eviction of persons unlawfully occupying premises with no legal right to do so.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A CASE-TRACKING SYSTEM FOR DIVORCE PROCEEDINGS INVOLVING DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To strengthen court supports for a victim of domestic violence who is involved in a divorce proceeding.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ADOPTION OF THE NATIONAL COMMISSION ON CORRECTIONAL HEALTH SERVICES STANDARDS AND ACCREDITATION REQUIREMENTS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTION.
purpose: To establish mandatory adoption of National Commission on Correctional Health Care standards and accreditation requirements for Department of Correction facilities, ensuring standardized high-quality health care services for persons who are incarcerated.

primary_sponsors: REP. LUCY DATHAN, 142nd DIST.; REP. MIKE DEMICCO, 21st DIST.; REP. JAY M. CASE, 63rd DIST.; SEN. MATTHEW L. LESSER, 9th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF SUPPORTED DECISION-MAKING AGREEMENTS IN LIEU OF CONSERVATORSHIPS OR GUARDIANSHIPS.
purpose: To implement the use of supported decision-making agreements as a less restrictive alternative to the use of conservatorships or guardianships for adults with disabilities.
cosponsors: Rep. Eleni Kavros DeGraw, 17th Dist.; Rep. Steven Winter, 94th Dist.; Rep. Jillian Gilchrest, 18th Dist.; Rep. Gary A. Turco, 27th Dist.; Sen. Derek Slap, 5th Dist.; Rep. Patrick Biggins, 11th Dist.; Rep. Greg S. Howard, 43rd Dist.; Rep. Maryam Khan, 5th Dist.; Rep. Josh Elliott, 88th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. DATHAN, 142nd Dist.; REP. DEMICCO, 21st Dist.; REP. CASE, 63rd Dist.; SEN. LESSER, 9th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM FOR THE MEDIATION OF CONDOMINIUM-RELATED DISPUTES.
purpose: To establish a program within the Probate Court system for the mediation of disputes that arise between condominium unit owners and associations.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE STAY OF EXECUTION OF A PROBATE COURT ORDER AUTHORIZING THE ADMINISTRATION OF SHOCK THERAPY.
purpose: To require an automatic stay of execution of a Probate Court order authorizing the administration of shock therapy to a respondent in order to allow the respondent sufficient time to seek review of such order.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF PROBATE COURT JUDGES.
purpose: To establish requirements applicable to Probate Court judges that eliminate potential conflicts of interest, enhance professionalism and conform with requirements applicable to other members of the judiciary.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY OWNER'S LIABILITY FOR EXPENSES INCURRED AS A RESULT OF A FALLING TREE OR TREE LIMB.
purpose: To incentivize the responsible stewardship of trees on privately owned real property and protect neighboring property and occupants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROBATE COURT VENUE FOR THE FILING OF A PETITION RELATING TO THE ADMINISTRATION OF ELECTROCONVULSIVE THERAPY TO A PATIENT.
purpose: To remove a barrier to electroconvulsive treatment for a patient who is not hospitalized in a location where such treatment is medically advised.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COURT AWARD OF ATTORNEY'S FEES IN BAD FAITH AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS.
purpose: To authorize a court to assess attorney's fees against a losing party in an action brought under section 8-30g of the general statutes if the court determines that the action was brought in bad faith.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE FILING FEE FOR ANNUAL REPORTS FILED BY CERTAIN BUSINESS ENTITIES WITH THE OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE.
purpose: To assist small businesses by decreasing the amount of the fee for filing annual business reports with the Office of the Secretary of the State from eighty dollars to forty dollars.
cosponsors: Sen. Ryan Fazio, 36th Dist.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING FOR THE PROVISION OF CHILD SUPPORT FOR CHILDREN UNDER THE AGE OF TWENTY-ONE.
purpose: To ensure that children of families who would have provided financial support to their children in their young adult years had the family remained intact continue to benefit from the financial support when the family is no longer intact.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAUSE OF ACTION AGAINST THE STATE FOR INJURY OR ILLNESS CAUSED TO A STUDENT AS A RESULT OF VACCINATION OR MEDICINAL TREATMENT REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To create a cause of action allowing a student to recover actual and punitive damages for injuries or illness caused by a vaccination or medicinal treatment program if the state required the student to receive the vaccine or medicinal treatment as a condition of school admission.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Donna Veach, 30th Dist.; Rep. Karen Reddington-Hughes, 66th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.; Rep. Joe Hoxha, 78th Dist.; Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Doug Dubitsky, 47th Dist.; Rep. Kurt Vail, 52nd Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING CASELOADS FOR PUBLIC DEFENDERS.
purpose: To alleviate the burden placed on the state's public defenders who experience high caseloads, making it difficult to provide adequate legal representation to high-needs populations.
cosponsors: Rep. Maryam Khan, 5th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF THE PROBATE COURT TO ORDER A PERSON WITH INTELLECTUAL AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES TO SUBMIT TO AN INVOLUNTARY MEDICAL EVALUATION AND ASSISTED OUTPATIENT MEDICAL TREATMENT.
purpose: To provide the Probate Court and conservators of the person with greater authority to order a person with intellectual and developmental disabilities to submit to an involuntary medical evaluation and assisted outpatient medical treatment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY AS A DEFENSE IN CIVIL ACTIONS RESULTING FROM DEPRIVATION OF EQUAL PROTECTION OF THE LAWS OF THE STATE COMMITTED BY A STATE ELECTED OFFICIAL.
purpose: To ensure state elected officials are held to the same standard as police officers in protecting the Constitutional rights of state residents.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE AGENCIES FROM TAKING CERTAIN ACTIONS AGAINST PARENTS AND GUARDIANS WHO CHOOSE TO RAISE CHILDREN CONSISTENT WITH THEIR BIOLOGICAL SEX.
purpose: To prohibit state agencies from taking certain action against a parent or guardian if the basis for such action relates solely to such parent's or guardian's decision to raise a child consistent with such child's biological sex.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PER-CHILD FOSTER CARE MAINTENANCE PAYMENT RATE.
purpose: To increase the per-child foster care maintenance payment rate to one thousand one hundred dollars per month.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NOTICE OF FIREARMS BY OPERATORS OF FAMILY CHILD CARE HOMES.
purpose: To require (1) family child care home operators to notify parents and guardians of the presence of firearms, and (2) the Office of Early Childhood to take adverse licensing action against operators for violation of said requirement.
cosponsors: Rep. Liz Linehan, 103rd Dist.

primary_sponsors: REP. MARY WELANDER, 114th DIST.; REP. ELENI KAVROS DEGRAW, 17th DIST.; REP. COREY P. PARIS, 145th DIST.; REP. AIMEE BERGER-GIRVALO, 111th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF BLOCKED TRUST ACCOUNTS FOR CERTAIN MINORS.
purpose: To require any parent or guardian who receives income from the creation of online content featuring a minor in such parent or guardian's care to establish a blocked trust account, which shall be accessible to such minor when such minor turns eighteen years of age.
introduced_by: REP. WELANDER, 114th Dist.; REP. KAVROS DEGRAW, 17th Dist.; REP. PARIS, 145th Dist.; REP. BERGER -GIRVALO, 111th Dist.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE FOR THE POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION EXPENSES OF FOSTER YOUTH.
purpose: To require the Department of Children and Families to continue to provide financial aid for the postsecondary education expenses for foster youth until such youth reaches twenty-eight years of age.
cosponsors: Rep. Mary Welander, 114th Dist.; Rep. Sarah Keitt, 134th Dist.; Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPOINTMENT OF THE CHILD ADVOCATE.
purpose: To modify the appointment process for the Child Advocate.
cosponsors: Rep. Mary Welander, 114th Dist.; Rep. Jaime S. Foster, 57th Dist.; Rep. Kenneth Gucker, 138th Dist.; Sen. Heather S. Somers, 18th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TREATMENT OF CHILDREN WITH GAMBLING DISORDERS.
purpose: To (1) permit counselors certified by the International Gambling Counselor Certification Board to treat gambling disorders in children sixteen years of age or older without notifying such children's parents or guardians, and (2) require the Department of Children and Families to employ a clinician certified by the International Gambling Counselor Certification Board.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSUMPTION OF ENERGY DRINKS BY CHILDREN.
purpose: To establish a working group to study the medical risks associated with the consumption of energy drinks by children and effects of a prohibition on the sale of energy drinks to children, and require signage related to the medical risks associated with the consumption of energy drinks by children.
cosponsors: Rep. Liz Linehan, 103rd Dist.; Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAL RECORDS PERTAINING TO PRENATAL CARE AND MANDATED REPORTS.
purpose: To specify that a mandated reporter shall not include medical records pertaining to prenatal care in a report to the Commissioner of Children and Families.
cosponsors: Rep. Kai J. Belton, 100th Dist.; Rep. Laurie Sweet, 91st Dist.; Rep. Sarah Keitt, 134th Dist.; Rep. Trenee McGee, 116th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MANUFACTURING INNOVATION FUND.
purpose: To supply funding to be deposited into the Manufacturing Innovation Fund to support manufacturing apprenticeships in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TIME FOR PASSAGE OF THE STATE BUDGET.
purpose: To prevent legislators and constitutional officers from being paid unless a state budget is passed on time.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO THE DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS FOR ADVERTISING CAMPAIGNS TO PROMOTE AWARENESS OF MENTAL AND BEHAVIORAL HEALTH RESOURCES.
purpose: To appropriate funds to the Department of Veterans Affairs for purposes of advertising campaigns to promote awareness of mental and behavioral health resources available to veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE OCCUPATIONAL AND PROFESSIONAL LICENSING DIVISION WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION.
purpose: To fund additional in-the-field license inspector positions in the Occupational and Professional Licensing Division of the Department of Consumer Protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING TO COMPENSATE MUNICIPALITIES FOR COSTS INCURRED BECAUSE OF EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To help our towns cover the costs of early voting.
cosponsors: Sen. Paul Cicarella, 34th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONTINUED FUNDING SUPPORT FOR THE GOVERNOR'S FOOT GUARDS AND HORSE GUARDS.
purpose: To preserve the Governor's Foot Guards and Horse Guards and the property where the Governor's Horse Guards' headquarters is located in the town of Avon.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE FUNDING OF THE OFFICE OF EQUITY AND OPPORTUNITY.
purpose: To prohibit the Office of Equity and Opportunity from receiving any state funds to support the office or its functions.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING REPORTS CONCERNING THE TERMINATION OF CERTAIN FUNDS AND ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To require certain disclosures regarding the termination of funds and accounts that are established pursuant to a public or special act, administered by the state, a state agency or a department, institution, bureau, board, commission, authority or official of the state, and intended for a charitable purpose.
cosponsors: Rep. Mitch Bolinsky, 106th Dist.; Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING INDIVIDUALS WITH GRADUATE DEGREES TO TEACH IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS.
purpose: To allow an individual with a graduate degree to teach a subject relevant to such degree in a public school.
cosponsors: Sen. Heather S. Somers, 18th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING EVENING TRADE AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING PROGRAMS AT TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND CAREER SCHOOLS.
purpose: To establish training programs for adults in trades and vocations that are in high demand in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TERMINATION HEARINGS FOR TENURED TEACHERS.
purpose: To require three-member panels for termination hearings for teachers who have attained tenure.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY TEACHER COMPENSATION.
purpose: To establish a task force to study teacher compensation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND OF THE PRESS FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To protect student expression and student publications except when such expression or publications are obscene, libelous, slanderous or disrupt school activities.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Karen Reddington-Hughes, 66th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Joe Hoxha, 78th Dist.; Rep. Donna Veach, 30th Dist.; Rep. Brian Lanoue, 45th Dist.; Rep. Kurt Vail, 52nd Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE PROMOTION OF RACIAL AND SEXUAL SUPREMACY IN SCHOOLS IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To ensure that all students are treated fairly and equally in Connecticut's schools.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Karen Reddington-Hughes, 66th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Joe Hoxha, 78th Dist.; Rep. Donna Veach, 30th Dist.; Rep. Brian Lanoue, 45th Dist.; Rep. Kurt Vail, 52nd Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STUDENT ATHLETES WHO WERE BORN AS MALES FROM PARTICIPATING IN WOMEN'S INTERSCHOLASTIC ATHLETIC EVENTS.
purpose: To eliminate unfair competition in women's interscholastic sporting competition.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CREATING EDUCATION SAVINGS ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To create education savings accounts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PARTICIPATION OF HOME-SCHOOLED STUDENTS IN EXTRACURRICULAR AND ATHLETIC ACTIVITIES OFFERED BY SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To allow home-schooled children to participate in school extracurricular activities and interscholastic and intramural athletics.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF SPECIAL EDUCATION AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A NEUTRAL STATE PANEL FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To require the state to pay the full cost of special education and to establish a neutral state panel to decide special education placements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE EXCESS COST THRESHOLD FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To modify the excess cost threshold for special education costs in order to reduce the financial hardship on small school districts with low student enrollment.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE NOTICE PERIOD TO WITHDRAW FROM A COOPERATIVE ARRANGEMENT BETWEEN BOARDS OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To require three years', rather than one year, notice for a board of education to withdraw from an agreement for cooperative arrangements with any other board of education.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING PROFICIENCY EXAMINATIONS AND A PUBLIC SCHOOL VOUCHER PROGRAM.
purpose: To (1) require administration of a grade-level proficiency examination as a condition to elevating a student to the next grade level or allowing a student to graduate, and (2) allow the parent or guardian of a student who attends a school in which less than sixty per cent of students pass such grade-level proficiency examinations to obtain a voucher to enroll such child in a public school within the same or adjoining school district.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING COLLEGE ENTRANCE EXAMINATION PREPARATION COMPANIES FROM DISCLOSING OR SELLING STUDENT INFORMATION.
purpose: To protect the privacy of students taking college entrance exams.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC SCHOOLS BE EQUIPPED WITH CLASSROOM DOORS THAT LOCK FROM THE INSIDE.
purpose: To require all public school classrooms to be equipped with doors that are able to be locked from inside the classroom.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION EXCESS COST GRANT.

purpose: To manage the black bear population and protect the residents of the state.

cosponsors: Rep. Vincent J. Candelora, 86th Dist.; Sen. Heather S. Somers, 18th Dist.; Rep. Tami Zawistowski, 61st Dist.; Rep. Patrick E. Callahan, 108th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RENEWABLE PORTFOLIO STANDARD, THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY AND PUBLIC UTILITY AFFILIATE ENTITIES AND REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE ELECTRIC GRID OF THE STATE.
purpose: To (1) redefine "class I renewable energy source" to include any nuclear or hydropower energy source, (2) increase oversight of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority, (3) require an audit of the Combined Public Benefits Charge and any program supported by such charge, (4) require functional and operational separation of unregulated or underregulated affiliates of public utilities, (5) impose revenue transfer caps, (6) require a line-item audit of large electricity generation facilities, and (7) require a comprehensive study of the viability of the electric grid in the state.
cosponsors: Rep. Julio A. Concepcion, 4th Dist.
introduced_by: REP. SANTIAGO H., 84th Dist.; REP. BUMGARDNER, 41st Dist.; REP. SANCHEZ, 6th Dist.; REP. REYES, 75th Dist.; REP. CANDELARIA J., 95th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPLOYMENT OF SOLAR ENERGY SOURCES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To (1) set a goal of five hundred megawatts of solar photovoltaic electricity generation in the state not later than the year 2027, (2) remove the capacity limit on the Non-residential Renewable Energy Solutions Program, (3) extend the duration of the Shared Clean Energy Facility Program, (4) impose a uniform capacity tax for grid-scale solar photovoltaic installations, (5) streamline the process by which solar photovoltaic facilities are connected to the grid, and (6) create a solar advancement commission for the purpose of making policy recommendations concerning solar deployment in the state.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING FOR THE CREATION OF MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC COMPANIES BY REFERENDA AND ESTABLISHING THE CONNECTICUT PUBLIC TRANSMISSION AUTHORITY AND THE CONNECTICUT PUBLIC POWER CORPORATION.
purpose: To (1) allow any political subdivision of the state, including a municipality or regional council of governments, to hold a referendum to establish or join a municipal electric company, (2) establish a quasi-public entity known as the "Connecticut Public Transmission Authority" to acquire existing electric transmission assets from private entities at fair market value and to own, operate and maintain such assets in the state, and (3) establish a nonprofit entity known as the "Connecticut Public Power Corporation" to generate class I renewable energy sources in the state.

title: AN ACT REPEALING ANY CHARGE INCLUDED IN THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE.
purpose: To repeal any component of the Combined Public Benefits Charge.
cosponsors: Rep. Arnold Jensen, 131st Dist.

cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.
introduced_by: REP. ALLIE -BRENNAN, 2nd Dist.; SEN. FAZIO, 36th Dist.

purpose: To review statutes concerning the state funding sources for community access television channels.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC COMPANIES AND JOINT POWERS AUTHORITIES.
purpose: To (1) allow a municipality to establish a municipal electric company to provide electricity for residents of the municipality, and (2) establish a joint powers authority for the purpose of providing electrical supply, developing solar and battery projects and creating programs to encourage energy efficiency, electrical demand management and electric vehicle charger deployment.

primary_sponsors: REP. JAIME S. FOSTER, 57th DIST.; SEN. SAUD ANWAR, 3rd DIST.; REP. CAROL HALL, 59th DIST.

purpose: To require the Connecticut Siting Council to (1) consider the testimony of any witness and of the chief executive officer of the municipality in which a proposed facility is to be developed, (2) be bound by the approval, disapproval or imposition of conditions by the chief executive officer of the municipality in which a solar photovoltaic system with a generating capacity greater than one megawatt is proposed if such proposed system is located within a five-mile radius of any solar photovoltaic system with a generating capacity greater than one hundred megawatts, and (3) maintain distribution capacity for local projects that benefit schools, municipal, agricultural or local industry.
cosponsors: Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.; Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.
introduced_by: REP. FOSTER, 57th Dist.; SEN. ANWAR, 3rd Dist.; REP. HALL C., 59th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY CONVERTING BIOSOLIDS INTO ENERGY.
purpose: To create a task force to study converting biosolids into energy.

purpose: To require third-party electric suppliers to obtain surety bonds to ensure compliance with state and local laws.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLOSURES AND EVACUATIONS OF RESIDENTIAL CARE HOMES AND NURSING HOMES.
purpose: To (1) require nursing homes and residential care homes to consider resident proximity to family and other support networks when transferring or discharging a resident, (2) require the Commissioner of Public Health to study nursing home and residential care home evacuation procedures relating to transportation, (3) require nursing homes and residential care homes to maintain insurance for residents' personal property lost or damaged as a result of an evacuation, (4) establish a database that provides real-time tracking of nursing home and residential care home bed availability, (5) establish an automated benefits transfer system to facilitate the transfer of benefits and payments when a nursing home or residential care home resident is transferred to a new facility on an emergency basis, and (6) require the Commissioner of Public Health to study methods to employ alternative housing solutions to provide living arrangements to residential care home residents impacted by mandated bed reductions.

purpose: To require (1) adoption of (A) the state plan of conservation and development every ten years after July 1, 2030, (B) regional plans of conservation and development not later than one year after the adoption of the state plan of conservation and development beginning July 1, 2030, and (C) municipal plans of conservation and development not later than one year after the adoption of the regional plan of conservation and development for the region in which such municipality is located beginning July 1, 2030, and (2) approval of municipal plans of conservation and development by municipal legislative bodies and boards of selectmen.

purpose: To (1) require the Department of Transportation to fund the New Haven Line, (2) establish minimum train crew size requirements for freight railroad companies operating in the state, (3) require the installation of hotbox detectors every twenty miles on any rail line in which passenger trains operate, (4) increase the amount of bond funds available for grants for commercial rail line improvements, and (5) study the feasibility of operating hybrid trains on the Danbury branch line of the Metro-North Commuter Railroad and expanding such line to include the town of New Milford.
cosponsors: Rep. Travis Simms, 140th Dist.

Pelletier, (2) establish a work zone and roadside vehicle safety awareness program, (3) make distracted driving on a limited access highway a reckless driving violation, (4) increase the penalties for endangering a highway worker and violating the "move over" law, and (5) require the installation of six-inch-wide edge lines on limited access highways.

purpose: To expand upon the types of equitable relief and enforcement tools that may be utilized for violations of the Connecticut Antitrust Act.

purpose: To provide local and regional boards of education relief from certain education mandates.

purpose: To implement the recommendations of the School Crisis Response Drills Working Group regarding the development of protocols for conducting crisis response drills in schools.

purpose: To: (1) Allow owners of real property to seek the removal of unauthorized persons from such owner's real property; (2) revise the continuing education requirements for real estate licensees; (3) regulate wholesaling agreements between real estate wholesalers and sellers of residential property; (4) require the Commissioner of Housing to conduct a study concerning methods to advance equal access to housing and fairness in real estate transactions; and (5) change the term real estate salesperson to real estate agent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LICENSURE PORTABILITY FOR MARRIAGE AND FAMILY THERAPISTS.
purpose: To allow the Department of Public Health to grant licensure without examination to any person who is currently licensed or certified as a marital or marriage and family therapist or a marital and family therapist associate in another state, territory or commonwealth of the United States.
cosponsors: Rep. Patricia A. Dillon, 92nd Dist.; Rep. Tammy Nuccio, 53rd Dist.; Sen. Heather S. Somers, 18th Dist.; Sen. Rob Sampson, 16th Dist.; Rep. Gale L. Mastrofrancesco, 80th Dist.; Sen. Paul Cicarella, 34th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO THE MONEY TRANSMISSION STATUTES, STATE PAYMENTS AND INVESTMENTS IN VIRTUAL CURRENCY AND MINORS' MONEY SHARING APPLICATION ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To (1) define "virtual currency control services vendor", (2) establish requirements for virtual currency money transmission licensees concerning (A) disclosures, (B) receipts, (C) the use of virtual currency under the control of such licensees, and (D) the engagement of other persons to store or hold custody or control of virtual currency for or on behalf of a customer, (3) establish that certain virtual currency held by such licensees shall be deemed to be property interests of any claimants against such licensees, and (4) prohibit the state, and political subdivisions of the state, from (A) accepting or requiring payment in the form of virtual currency, or (B) purchasing, holding, investing in or establishing a reserve of virtual currency.
cosponsors: Rep. Kenneth Gucker, 138th Dist.; Sen. Patricia Billie Miller, 27th Dist.; Sen. Matthew L. Lesser, 9th Dist.; Rep. Jason Doucette, 13th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO THE CREDIT UNION STATUTES RELATING TO NONMEMBER PAYMENTS, MEMBER BUSINESS LOANS, CHARITABLE CONTRIBUTIONS, EXTENSIONS OF CREDIT, CAPITAL AND NET WORTH.
purpose: To (1) define "loan officer" for the purposes of various statutes relating to credit unions, (2) establish that certain credit unions may receive certain payments from nonmembers, (3) redefine "member business loan" for the purposes of certain statutory provisions relating to credit union loans, (4) establish that the management of Connecticut credit unions may make certain charitable contributions and gifts, (5) establish that employees, insiders or members of the governing board of Connecticut credit unions may obtain extensions of credit with preferential rates, terms or conditions, (6) establish that a Connecticut credit union may adopt policies establishing the manner in which such Connecticut credit union characterizes the proceeds of the resale of repossessed goods, and (7) redefine "capital" and "net worth" for the purposes of various statutory provisions relating to credit unions.
cosponsors: Rep. Farley Santos, 109th Dist.; Sen. Patricia Billie Miller, 27th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO DEVELOP AN ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND TOURISM PLAN IN THE GREATER MYSTIC AREA.
purpose: To establish a working group to develop a plan regarding economic development and tourism in the greater Mystic area.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVIEW OF AND A TRANSITION TO THE RELEASE-BASED CLEANUP PROGRAM AND RELATED REGULATIONS.
purpose: To review the transition to a release-based cleanup program.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY TO OPEN A DOCKET CONCERNING THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE.
purpose: To require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to open a docket for the purpose of redesigning customer electric bills to (1) increase a customer's understanding of such bills, and (2) separate federally mandated congestion charges from the systems benefits charge on such bills.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMMUNITY SOLAR ENERGY GENERATING SYSTEMS.
purpose: To (1) allow shared clean energy subscriber organizations to build, own and operate electrical generation or storage facilities that generate or store electricity from renewable sources, (2) allow any end user of an electric distribution company to enter into a subscription with a shared clean energy subscriber organization, and (3) require any electric distribution company to provide billing credits to any end user who enters into such a subscription.
cosponsors: Rep. Hector Arzeno, 151st Dist.; Rep. Mary M. Mushinsky, 85th Dist.; Rep. Tom O'Dea, 125th Dist.; Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.; Rep. Kerry S. Wood, 29th Dist.; Rep. Savet Constantine, 42nd Dist.; Rep. William Heffernan, 115th Dist.; Rep. James Sanchez, 6th Dist.; Rep. Juan R. Candelaria, 95th Dist.; Rep. Kenneth Gucker, 138th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY TO STUDY ALTERNATIVE ENERGY DELIVERY METHODS, DEVELOP A CAPITAL INVESTMENT FUNDING MECHANISM AND INCREASE THE FREQUENCY OF RATE ADJUSTMENT PROCEEDINGS.
purpose: To require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to (1) study alternative energy delivery methods, (2) develop a capital investment funding mechanism, (3) increase the frequency of rate adjustment proceedings, (4) study innovative rate plans to stabilize customer electric bills, and (5) study service termination protections for persons with serious illnesses or life-threatening medical conditions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS CAMPAIGN FINANCE REFORMS RECOMMENDED BY THE STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION.
purpose: To (1) provide clarification to the term "solicit" by defining the term "collector", (2) redefine "organization expenditure" to include campaign events at which a candidate or candidates are present, (3) impose liability upon certain campaign-related vendors who do not provide to qualified candidate committee treasurers the information necessary for such treasurers to perform their duties under campaign finance laws, (4) move the timing of the consumer price index adjustments for individual contribution amounts and the aggregate contribution amounts candidates are required to raise, from January of the election year to (A) not later than July 3, 2025, for elections held in 2026, and (B) January of the prior year for elections held in subsequent cycles, (5) beginning with the 2030 election, allow major party candidates for Governor to apply for convention campaign grants beginning the January of the year preceding the election, (6) provide that candidates who change their party status after filing their grant applications are ineligible to receive additional grant funds, and (7) address approvals of grant applications in relation to the timing of such consumer price index adjustments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TIMING AND SCOPE OF AUDITS BY THE AUDITORS OF PUBLIC ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To require the Auditors of Public Accounts to provide a proposed schedule of audits to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to government oversight, and to authorize such committee to request the auditors to conduct more frequent audits or performance audits of state agencies.
cosponsors: Rep. Kenneth Gucker, 138th Dist.; Rep. Kerry S. Wood, 29th Dist.; Rep. Henry J. Genga, 10th Dist.; Sen. Heather S. Somers, 18th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUDITS OF THE UTILITY PROGRAMS OVERSEEN BY THE ENERGY CONSERVATION MANAGEMENT BOARD.
purpose: To subject entities that provide energy assessments funded by the Clean Energy Fund to residential homeowners to biennial audit by the Auditors of Public Accounts.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE AUDITORS OF PUBLIC ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Auditors of Public Accounts submitted in their most recent annual report, including to require Governor or Attorney General approval for additional agreements with state employees over a certain amount, require agreements with foundations to provide when foundations shall reimburse the expenses, salaries and benefits of state employees providing services for the foundation, require adoption of state agency complaint processing procedures, remove the Comptroller from the Treasurer's audit, remove the State Contracting Standard Board's ability to request the auditors to conduct its audits, modify provisions concerning state agency contracts and agreements for auditing services and add a time frame for quasi-public agency annual reports to the auditors.
cosponsors: Rep. Kenneth Gucker, 138th Dist.; Rep. Henry J. Genga, 10th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REFERENDA, INDEPENDENT EXPENDITURES AND OTHER CAMPAIGN FINANCE CHANGES.
purpose: To (1) implement federal court rulings regarding independent expenditure political committees and contributions to such committees, (2) reflect federal case law on aggregate contribution limits for individuals, (3) more explicitly recognize referendum spending as a type of independent expenditure and make changes related to reporting and attribution requirements, (4) adjust a disclaimer requirement to address certain organization expenditures, (5) make a conforming change regarding the distribution of surplus funds by candidate committees participating in the Citizens' Election Program, (6) allow the State Elections Enforcement Commission additional time to investigate certain complaints, (7) establish in-state contributor requirements for state-wide candidates participating in said program, and (8) specify that individual contributions under said program may not exceed already-established contribution limits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TUITION REFUNDS FOR FORMER STONE ACADEMY STUDENTS.

purpose: To reduce the number of new full-time equivalents required under the JobsCT tax rebate program for a qualified business with seventy-five or fewer employees.

purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for a portion of the rent paid for a primary residence in the state by taxpayers who meet certain income thresholds.
cosponsors: Rep. Jason Rojas, 9th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTAIN TAX APPEALS, THE DISAGGREGATION OF CERTAIN TAX SOURCING INFORMATION, THE AMORTIZABLE BOND PREMIUM SUBTRACTION FOR PURPOSES OF THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX AND THE APPLICATION OF VALUATION ALLOWANCE FOR CERTAIN COMBINED GROUP REPORTING.
purpose: To (1) establish requirements for filing certain tax protests, (2) require the Commissioner of Revenue Services to provide certain disaggregated tax sourcing information; (3) eliminate the requirement that the amortizable bond premium subtraction for purposes of calculating Connecticut adjustable gross income be attributable to a trade or business of the taxpayer, and (4) revise certain dates with respect to the application of the valuation allowance under section 12-218h of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY BEVERAGE CONTAINER REDEMPTION RATES IN THE STATE AND REDUCING A FEE ON INFUSED BEVERAGE CONTAINERS.
purpose: To (1) establish a working group to study the redemption rates of beverage containers in the state and the effect of the increase in refund value on such rates and beverage consumption and costs to deposit initiators, and (2) reduce the fee on infused beverage containers and legacy infused beverage containers to five cents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INDEXING OF PERSONAL INCOME TAX THRESHOLDS AND PERSONAL EXEMPTION AMOUNTS, THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A CHILD TAX CREDIT AND THE DEDUCTION AND WITHHOLDING OF PERSONAL INCOME TAX FROM CERTAIN PAYMENTS AND DISTRIBUTIONS.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE AND PATIENT PROTECTION.
purpose: To: (1) Establish (A) certain reporting requirements and enforcement provisions concerning compliance with mental health and substance use disorder benefit laws, and (B) the parity advancement account; (2) require health carriers to bear the burden of proving that certain health care services under adverse determination or utilization review are not medically necessary; (3) establish certain prohibitions on the use of step therapy for prescription drugs; (4) require health carriers to include certain provisions in contracts with health care providers regarding reimbursement for certain covered health benefits; (5) establish certain requirements concerning stop loss insurance policies for health care or medical benefits under any self-funded employee health benefit plan; (6) establish certain health insurance rate filing requirements and require that the Insurance Commissioner adopt regulations concerning affordability in rate filing; (7) prohibit the use of artificial intelligence to make an adverse determination based on medical necessity; and (8) prohibit any individual or group health insurance policy from imposing (A) arbitrary time limits on reimbursement for general anesthesia services, or (B) unilateral arbitrary limitations on reimbursement for medically necessary ancillary services.

purpose: To establish a working group to study how to keep biased, partisan politics out of the nonprofit sector.
cosponsors: Sen. Rob Sampson, 16th Dist.

purpose: To prevent compelled speech by prohibiting the state or any political subdivision of the state from requiring the use of specific pronouns.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL OF CERTAIN EXECUTIVE ORDERS ISSUED WHILE THE LEGISLATURE IS IN SESSION.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP AND OFFICE TO UNCOVER FRAUD AND WASTE IN STATE GOVERNMENT.
purpose: To prevent the waste of taxpayer dollars and investigate and prosecute claims of fraud or waste within state agencies or by private providers.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF CERTAIN SOCIAL NETWORKING APPLICATIONS ON STATE GOVERNMENT ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT.
purpose: To prohibit the use of TikTok and WeChat applications on state government electronic equipment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPEN AND EARLIER PRIMARIES.
purpose: To allow unaffiliated electors to vote in political party primaries and require that such primaries be held earlier in the calendar year.

title: AN ACT PROCLAIMING THE TOWN OF ENFIELD AS THE "GATEWAY TO CONNECTICUT".
purpose: To proclaim the town of Enfield as the "Gateway to Connecticut".

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING GROCERY STORE WINE SALES.
purpose: To authorize grocery store wine sales.

purpose: To provide that certain businesses shall not sell consumers' genetic information to third parties.

purpose: To prohibit the manufacture, distribution, delivery or sale of foods containing certain additives.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING DISCLOSURE OF TAXES AND GOVERNMENT-MANDATED FEES ON SIGNAGE ADVERTISING THE PRICE OF GASOLINE OR DIESEL FUEL.
purpose: To provide that any signage advertising the price of gasoline or diesel fuel shall disclose the nature and amount of each tax or government-mandated fee levied or imposed for such gasoline or diesel fuel.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A RECIPROCAL SKILLED TRADE LICENSING AGREEMENT WITH OTHER STATES.
purpose: To provide for a reciprocal skilled trade licensing agreement with other states.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

purpose: To further specify the circumstances in which a pharmacist shall dispense a drug prescribed to treat attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BEER DISTRIBUTION.
purpose: To modify certain requirements concerning self-distribution by beer manufacturer permittees and study how such permittees can more easily terminate contracts with wholesaler permittees.

title: AN ACT ADOPTING THE HUMAN CELL PRODUCT LABELING ACT.
purpose: To adopt the Human Cell Product Labeling Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CYBERBULLYING.
purpose: To establish additional protections against cyberbullying on social media platforms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COTTAGE FOOD OPERATIONS.
purpose: To authorize cottage food operations to sell their products at certain farm stores and cafes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SINGLE SKILLED TRADE APPRENTICESHIP HIRING RATIO.
purpose: To establish a single skilled trade hiring ratio of one apprentice to one licensee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH CLUB MEMBERSHIP CANCELLATION.
purpose: To specify the time period within which a health club must process a membership cancellation.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CONSUMERS' CONSENT TO STORE CREDIT CARD OR OTHER PAYMENT INFORMATION.
purpose: To require any person doing business in this state to obtain written consent from a consumer before storing the consumer's credit card or other payment information.

title: AN ACT LIMITING SCHOLARSHIP DISPLACEMENT.
purpose: To prohibit institutions of higher education from reducing the amount of institutional financial aid or grant under the Roberta B. Willis Scholarship program awarded to a student as a result of such student receiving a scholarship.

purpose: To require public institutions of higher education to freeze tuition for the purpose of making higher education costs more predictable.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FREE SPEECH ON CAMPUSES OF INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To require institutions of higher education to adopt policies in accordance with federal and state constitutional free speech protections.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE FEASIBILITY OF ESTABLISHING AN ADULT PROTECTIVE SERVICES INTAKE UNIT WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF AGING AND DISABILITY SERVICES.
purpose: To support senior citizens vulnerable to the risk of fraud and abuse.

purpose: To ensure equitable payment rates for durable medical equipment, supplies and complex rehabilitation technology.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF AGING IN PLACE PROGRAMS.
purpose: To expand opportunities for senior citizens to remain independently in their homes and communities and avoid costs to the state and senior citizens for institutionalization.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY EXPANDING SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE 2-1-1 INFOLINE PROGRAM OPERATED BY THE UNITED WAY OF CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To establish a task force to make recommendations on expanding and improving services offered by the 2-1-1 Infoline program operated by the United Way of Connecticut with state support.
cosponsors: Sen. Paul Cicarella, 34th Dist.; Sen. Tony Hwang, 28th Dist.; Sen. Jeff Gordon, 35th Dist.; Sen. Jason Perillo, 21st Dist.

title: AN ACT LIMITING STATE BENEFITS TO LEGAL RESIDENTS.
purpose: To uphold fidelity to federal immigration law and restrict state benefits to legal residents.
cosponsors: Sen. Rob Sampson, 16th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PREVENTION OF FRAUD AND ABUSE BY PERSONS CLAIMING TO HAVE SERVICE ANIMALS.
purpose: To prevent fraud and abuse of the special protections that are afforded to service animals and the owners of such animals.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A MEDICAID WAIVER TO REQUIRE CERTAIN ADULT MEDICAID RECIPIENTS TO WORK.
purpose: To reduce barriers to employment for young adult Medicaid beneficiaries who are able to obtain work but fear losing benefits.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING AUDITS FOR POTENTIAL PUBLIC ASSISTANCE FRAUD.
purpose: To promote the integrity of public assistance benefit distribution by reducing the potential for fraud.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A FULLY STAFFED STATE MEDICAID FRAUD CONTROL UNIT IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE AFFORDABLE CARE ACT.
purpose: To reduce fraud, waste and misuse of state resources.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING ABLE-BODIED RECIPIENTS OF PUBLIC ASSISTANCE TO WORK OR VOLUNTEER.
purpose: To promote work and self-sufficiency among able-bodied, adult recipients of public assistance.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID PAYMENT RATES FOR RADIOLOGICAL SERVICES.
purpose: To increase Medicaid reimbursement rates for radiological services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR SUBSTANCE ABUSE RECOVERY COACHES.
purpose: To support recovery from substance abuse for state residents by providing Medicaid reimbursement for substance abuse recovery coaches.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID RATES TO THE CORRESPONDING RATES OF MEDICARE REIMBURSEMENT.
purpose: To equalize Medicaid and Medicare payment rates for physicians, ambulance services and other health care professionals.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID RATES FOR COMMUNITY HOSPITALS IN RURAL AREAS.
purpose: To increase Medicaid reimbursement rates for community hospitals in rural areas to the corresponding Medicare rates.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING LEGISLATIVE CONFIRMATION OF THE APPOINTMENT OF THE DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICE'S MEDICAID DIRECTOR.
purpose: To require legislative confirmation of the Medicaid director.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING THE TRANSFER OF A COMPLAINT FROM A FAIR RENT COMMISSION TO THE SUPERIOR COURT.
purpose: To allow transfer of a complaint from a fair rent commission to the Superior Court.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EXEMPTION FROM THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCEDURE FOR A MUNICIPALITY CONTAINING AN AQUIFER PROTECTION AREA.
purpose: To include municipalities containing large aquifer protection areas in the exemption from the affordable housing appeals procedure.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL FAIR RENT COMMISSION HEARINGS BE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC.
purpose: To require all fair rent commission hearings be open to the public.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT A FAIR RENT COMMISSION AWARD ATTORNEY'S FEES TO THE PREVAILING PARTY.
purpose: To require that a fair rent commission award attorney's fees to the prevailing party.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE DEFINITION OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To expand the definition of affordable housing development to include properties that are not deed restricted.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXEMPTIONS FROM THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCESS FOR BOROUGHS.
purpose: To allow any borough to qualify for an exemption from the affordable housing appeals process separately from the municipality of which such borough is a political subdivision.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A HEALTH SAVINGS OR FLEXIBLE SPENDING ACCOUNT FOR VETERINARY EXPENSES.
purpose: To allow residents of this state to use such resident's health savings account or flexible spending account to pay for veterinary expenses.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH INSURERS FROM REQUIRING SPOUSES OF COVERED EMPLOYEES TO OBTAIN SEPARATE HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE.
purpose: To prohibit health insurers from requiring that spouses of covered employees obtain separate health insurance coverage, if available.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER PROTECTION IN THE LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE MARKET.
purpose: To ensure consumer protection in the long-term care insurance market and provide incentives to purchase long-term care insurance.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OFFICE OF HEALTH STRATEGY ACCOUNTABILITY AND TRANSPARENCY.
purpose: To require that the Office of Health Strategy conduct additional reporting, accounting and transparency measures.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN ANNUAL AUDIT AND REPORT CONCERNING CERTAIN HEALTH CARE PLANS ADMINISTERED BY THIS STATE.
purpose: To provide for greater transparency in, and legislative oversight of, health care plans administered by this state and offered to persons other than state employees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF PREMIUM RATES ON LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To: (1) Evaluate an alternative pool for long-term care policyholders in excess of twenty years; (2) require that the Insurance Department hold a public hearing for long-term care premium rate increase requests that exceed ten per cent; and (3) require that long-term care insurers provide potential policyholders with explicit notice, prior to the purchase of long-term care insurance policies, of the high risk of future premium rate increases.

primary_sponsors: SEN. TONY HWANG, 28th DIST.; REP. CARA CHRISTINE PAVALOCK-D'AMATO, 77th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STATE-OPERATED REINSURANCE PROGRAM AND THE REGULATION OF HEALTH CARE COST GROWTH.
purpose: To establish a state-operated reinsurance program and reduce the cost of health care in this state.
introduced_by: SEN. HWANG, 28th Dist.; REP. PAVALOCK -D'AMATO, 77th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. TONY HWANG, 28th DIST.; REP. CARA CHRISTINE PAVALOCK-D'AMATO, 77th DIST.; REP. TAMMY NUCCIO, 53rd DIST.

purpose: To permit sponsoring associations greater than a specified membership threshold to create multiple employer welfare arrangements.
introduced_by: SEN. HWANG, 28th Dist.; REP. PAVALOCK -D'AMATO, 77th Dist.; REP. NUCCIO, 53rd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISTINCT BILLING SYSTEMS FOR HOSPITALS AND OFF-CAMPUS PROVIDER DEPARTMENTS OF HOSPITALS.
purpose: To require: (1) Off-campus provider departments of hospitals to obtain a separate national provider identifier and tax identification number from the main hospital campus; and (2) hospitals to use industry standard paper and electronic billing forms when billing for services provided at off-campus outpatient sites.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS FROM THE INSURANCE AND INDEMNITY BOND REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To exempt nonprofit organizations from the insurance and indemnity bond requirements applicable to certain motor vehicle owners pursuant to subsection (a) of said section, provided the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles finds that such nonprofit organization has maintained sufficient financial responsibility to meet legal liability for personal injury, death or damage resulting from or caused by the use or operation of a service bus owned or operated by such nonprofit organization.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH INSURANCE COMPANIES FROM IMPOSING UNILATERAL TIME LIMITS ON COVERAGE FOR ANESTHESIA SERVICES.
purpose: To prohibit health insurance companies from imposing unilateral time limits on coverage for anesthesia services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT LEAVE PURSUANT TO THE CONNECTICUT PAID LEAVE AUTHORITY IS SECONDARY TO SHORT-TERM DISABILITY INSURANCE COVERAGE.
purpose: To require that leave pursuant to the Connecticut Paid Leave Authority is secondary to short-term disability insurance when individuals apply for short-term disability insurance coverage.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONNECTICUT HEALTH INSURANCE EXCHANGE BOARD OF DIRECTORS TO REPORT ADDITIONAL DATA.
purpose: To require the Connecticut Health Insurance Exchange board of directors to report additional data to the joint standing committees of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance and public health.

primary_sponsors: SEN. JEFF GORDON, 35th DIST.; SEN. SAUD ANWAR, 3rd DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT HEALTH CARRIERS COLLECT OUT-OF-POCKET EXPENSES FOR COVERED BENEFITS.
purpose: To require that health carriers collect any coinsurance, copayment, deductible or other out-of-pocket expense due and owing for a covered benefit that the health care provider provided to the insured.
introduced_by: SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.; SEN. ANWAR, 3rd Dist.

title: AN ACT LIMITING CHANGES TO PRESCRIPTION DRUG FORMULARIES FOR PSYCHIATRIC PRESCRIPTION DRUGS.
purpose: To limit the circumstances in which a health carrier may remove a psychiatric prescription drug from such health carrier's drug formulary or list of covered drugs, or move a psychiatric prescription drug to a different cost-sharing tier, during a policy term.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INSURANCE COVERAGE OF CERTAIN IN VITRO FERTILIZATION TREATMENTS FOR STATE AND MUNICIPAL FIREFIGHTERS DIAGNOSED WITH CANCER.
purpose: To require fertility and reproductive health insurance coverage for state and municipal firefighters diagnosed with cancer.
cosponsors: Rep. Greg S. Howard, 43rd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MEANING OF "OUT OF CELL" TIME FOR PERSONS WHO ARE INCARCERATED.
purpose: To clarify the meaning of "out of cell" time for persons who are incarcerated.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF BODY SCANNING MACHINES IN THE PUBLIC ENTRANCE AREAS OF CORRECTIONAL FACILITIES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Correction to report to the General Assembly on the use of body scanning machines in the public entrance areas of correctional facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FINES FOR CERTAIN DISCIPLINARY ACTIONS IN CORRECTIONAL FACILITIES AND THE DEPOSIT OF SUCH FINES INTO A FUND FOR THE BENEFIT OF ALL PERSONS WHO ARE INCARCERATED.
purpose: To allow for the assessment of fines for certain disciplinary actions in correctional facilities that shall be deposited in the Correctional General Welfare Fund for uses that may benefit all persons who are incarcerated.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN ATTEMPT TO ESCAPE OR ELUDE A POLICE OFFICER.
purpose: To increase the penalty for failure to stop and attempting to escape or elude law enforcement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSENT SEARCHES OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To permit consent searches of motor vehicles.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELIGIBILITY FOR NONJUDICIAL ADJUDICATION OF A DELINQUENCY COMPLAINT.
purpose: To restore the eligibility requirements of a juvenile being adjudicated nonjudicial prior to the 2023 change by the Judicial Branch's Rules Committee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPANSION OF THE USE OF REMOTE NOTARIZATION BY A NOTARY PUBLIC.
purpose: To expand the use of electronic remote notarization by a notary public using communication technology.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING PERSONS AGE SEVENTY OR OLDER TO OPT OUT OF JURY SERVICE.
purpose: To allow persons age seventy or older to opt out of service as a juror.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PENALTIES FOR CRIMINAL OFFENSES AND PUBLIC SAFETY.
purpose: To restore public safety, prosecute criminals and protect victims.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PAYMENT OF FINANCIAL RESTITUTION BY A PERSON WHO CAUSES THE DEATH OF ANOTHER PERSON WHILE OPERATING A MOTOR VEHICLE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF AN INTOXICATING LIQUOR OR DRUG.
purpose: To permit a court to order that impaired drivers who cause the death of another person pay restitution in the form of child support to the surviving spouse or other relative of the deceased victim until the children of such victim are eighteen years of age.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE UNAUTHORIZED DISSEMINATION OF SYNTHETIC INTIMATE IMAGES OF ANOTHER PERSON.
purpose: To prohibit unauthorized dissemination of certain synthetic images.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE TRUST ACT.
purpose: To repeal the Trust Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSONS WHO ARE INCARCERATED BREASTFEEDING THEIR INFANTS.
purpose: To permit lactating persons who are incarcerated to breastfeed their infants during visits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADOPTION OF THE UNIFORM REAL PROPERTY TRANSFER ON DEATH ACT.
purpose: To provide for the adoption of the Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING IMMUNITY FROM CIVIL LIABILITY TO A PHYSICIAN WHO ACCOMPANIES AND ASSISTS A STATE, REGIONAL OR MUNICIPAL SWAT TEAM.
purpose: To provide immunity to a physician who accompanies and assists a state, regional or municipal SWAT team.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT REPEALING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF PA 20-1 OF THE JULY SPECIAL SESSION, ALSO KNOWN AS THE POLICE ACCOUNTABILITY ACT.
purpose: To repeal certain restrictions on law enforcement and protect officers and municipalities from frivolous lawsuits.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT CREATING A STATE CAUSE OF ACTION FOR INJURIES RECEIVED OR ILLNESS CAUSED BY VACCINATIONS OR MEDICINAL TREATMENT REQUIRED AS A CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To create a cause of action allowing an employee to recover actual and punitive damages for injuries or illness caused by a vaccination or medicinal treatment program if the employer required the employee to receive the vaccine or medicinal treatment as a condition of employment.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT INCENTIVIZING EDUCATIONAL AND WORKFORCE ACHIEVEMENT AS A MEANS OF REDUCING A PROBATIONER'S TERM OF SUPERVISION.
purpose: To incentivize educational and workforce achievement as a means of reducing a probationer's term of supervision.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STOPPING A MOTOR VEHICLE IF THE OPERATOR OR A PASSENGER IS SMOKING CANNABIS.
purpose: To permit a law enforcement officer to stop a motor vehicle if the officer witnesses the operator or a passenger smoking cannabis.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSENT SEARCHES OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To permit consent searches of motor vehicles.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSIDERATION OF PUBLIC SAFETY WHEN DETERMINING WHETHER TO TRANSFER A JUVENILE TO ADULT COURT.
purpose: To place greater weight on the safety of the public when a court considers the transference of a juvenile to adult court.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCRETIONARY TRANSFER FROM JUVENILE TO ADULT COURT.
purpose: To include serious firearm offenses in the list of offenses eligible for discretionary transfer from juvenile to adult court.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF STATE EMPLOYEES WORKING REMOTELY.
purpose: To study the fiscal impact and performance of state employees working remotely.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A CLEAR AND CONSPICUOUS STATEMENT CONCERNING AN EMPLOYEE'S RIGHT TO NOT PARTICIPATE IN A UNION.
purpose: To provide clear disclosures on collective bargaining agreements of a public employee's right to opt out of membership in a union.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADVANCE NOTICE OF THE NEED TO USE PAID SICK LEAVE.
purpose: To allow an employer to require an employee to provide advance notice of the intention to use paid sick leave if such leave is foreseeable.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PREVAILING WAGE FOR MUNICIPAL CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS.
purpose: To create an exemption from the prevailing wage requirements for municipalities experiencing undue financial hardships.

purpose: To expedite the application process for apprenticeship ratio relief and to require quarterly reports of denials of applications for apprenticeship ratio relief.

purpose: To lower the contribution cap of the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program to four-tenths of one per cent.

purpose: To aid in workforce development.

purpose: To include state employees in the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING WORKERS' COMPENSATION COVERAGE FOR POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS INJURIES.
purpose: To expand workers' compensation coverage for law enforcement and first responders experiencing post-traumatic stress injuries.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPALITIES TO IMPOSE CERTAIN EXCISE TAXES.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to impose excise taxes on occupancy, event venue rentals, and meals and beverages.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMMUNITY INVESTMENT BOARDS AND NEIGHBORHOOD ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To (1) require certain municipalities to establish community investment boards to identify priorities for the use of municipal revenue sharing grants and select grants for payment in lieu of taxes, (2) require the Office of Policy and Management to accept proposals for solutions to problems specific to urban areas and establish pilot programs to implement such proposals, and (3) establish a task force to study issues concerning nonprofit providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CALCULATION OF STATE FOREST LAND IN CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES FOR PURPOSES OF GRANTS IN LIEU OF TAXES PAYMENTS.
purpose: To calculate the value of state forest land, for purposes of grants in lieu of taxes payments by the state to municipalities, as real property for any municipality in which over fifty per cent of the land within such municipality's boundaries is state forest.

title: AN ACT RESTRICTING PROPERTY TAX GROWTH AND THE IMPOSITION OF NEW MANDATES ON MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To establish a cap on the annual growth of property tax imposed and require a two-thirds vote of the General Assembly for the imposition of any new mandate on a municipality.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO REVIEW UNFUNDED MUNICIPAL MANDATES.
purpose: To establish a working group to identify unfunded municipal mandates that, if eliminated, would result in cost savings to taxpayers.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE MUNICIPAL REGULATION OF FIREARMS.
purpose: To prohibit any municipality from adopting any ordinance or other regulation concerning the regulation of firearms.
cosponsors: Rep. Doug Dubitsky, 47th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE AND MUNICIPAL USE OF EMINENT DOMAIN FOR COMMERCIAL PURPOSES.
purpose: To prohibit the state and municipalities from exercising the use of eminent domain for commercial purposes.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INCLUSION OF A STATEMENT CONCERNING BOARD OF EDUCATION EXPENSES IN MUNICIPAL TAX BILLS.
purpose: To require that any tax assessment issued by a municipality to a taxpayer include a statement disclosing the amount of such assessment that will be used to fund the expenses of the local or regional board of education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRONIC BOOK LICENSING.
purpose: To require publishers of electronic books to license such books to public libraries on reasonable terms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To specify that qualifying veterans receive a property tax exemption for both the real property owned by such veteran and such veteran's dwelling located upon such real property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPROVAL OF ZONING REGULATION CHANGES AND PLANS OF CONSERVATION AND DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To (1) require that any change to any local zoning regulation be approved by the affirmative vote of the municipality's legislative body, and (2) allow a municipality to adopt an ordinance requiring the affirmative vote of the municipality's legislative body to approve the municipality's plan of conservation and development.

introduced_by: SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.; REP. DECAPRIO B., 48th Dist.

purpose: To address the shortage of health care professionals in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS TO NOTIFY PATIENTS REGARDING RECALLED MEDICAL DEVICES.
purpose: To ensure that patients receive notification of recalled medical devices.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CERTIFICATE OF NEED PROGRAM.

purpose: To name Connecticut Route 322 in Wolcott in honor of Eugene A. Migliaro, Jr., to recognize his service as a member of the United States Marine Corps, a member of the Connecticut House of Representatives, the mayor of Wolcott and the Commissioner of Veterans Affairs.

purpose: To require the display of a number plate only at the rear of a motor vehicle as a cost-saving measure.

purpose: To require the Commissioner of Transportation to obtain the approval of the municipality and any abutting property owner prior to erecting a permanent sign on a municipal highway.
cosponsors: Sen. Stephen G. Harding, 30th Dist.

purpose: To require the Department of Transportation to install sound barriers in the town of Fairfield to reduce the noise pollution created when the department clears trees.

purpose: To ensure appropriate rates and charges for nonconsensual towing that accounts for the costs and overhead expenses incurred by the towing company.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.
