cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF STATE FUNDS BY PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION FOR SPEAKING FEES.
purpose: To prohibit the use of state funds by public institutions of higher education for politically related speaking fees or events costs.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID COVERAGE OF MEDICAL ALERT SYSTEMS FOR ELDERLY MEDICAID RECIPIENTS.
purpose: To better protect senior Medicaid recipients by extending Medicaid coverage for medical alert systems.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REMOVAL OF AN UNAUTHORIZED INDIVIDUAL FROM REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To allow law enforcement to remove an individual from real property if such individual does not possess a signed written agreement authorizing the individual's occupancy.
cosponsors: Sen. Henri Martin, 31st Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A FAIR RENT COMMISSION DISMISS CERTAIN CASES.
purpose: To require a fair rent commission to dismiss any case when the rent increase for a dwelling unit is within the fair market rental value for comparable dwelling units in the neighborhood where the property is located.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR OPTIONAL PAYMENT OF THE HEALTHY HOMES FUND SURCHARGE.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that insureds under certain homeowners insurance policies pay, and provide for optional payment of, the surcharge imposed pursuant to section 38a-331 of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HEALTHY HOMES FUND SURCHARGE.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that insureds under certain homeowners insurance policies pay the surcharge imposed pursuant to section 38a-331 of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ASSESSMENTS AND USER FEES CHARGED TO HEALTH CARRIERS BY THE CONNECTICUT HEALTH INSURANCE EXCHANGE.
purpose: To require the exchange, established pursuant to section 38a-1081 of the general statutes, to gain legislative approval before: (1) Modifying any existing assessment or user fee charged to health carriers; or (2) charging any new assessment or user fee to health carriers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIABILITY FOR INJURIES OCCURRING IN A SKATEBOARD PARK OR DOG PARK MAINTAINED BY A MUNICIPALITY.
purpose: To reduce a municipality's exposure to liability for injuries occurring in a municipally maintained skateboard park or dog park.

title: AN ACT RESTORING CAPITAL PUNISHMENT.
purpose: To restore the death penalty in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REQUEST FOR PROOF OF AGE TO PURCHASE TOBACCO.
purpose: To reduce the burden on retailers by removing the requirement that an individual be required to produce proof of age each time the individual purchases tobacco if the retailer has previously reviewed such individual's identification and knows that the individual is twenty-one years of age or older.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT ENSURING THAT LOCAL AND STATE GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS FULLY COOPERATE WITH LAW ENFORCEMENT PERSONNEL IN THE ENFORCEMENT OF FEDERAL IMMIGRATION LAW.
purpose: To ensure that local and state officials are fully cooperating with law enforcement personnel in the enforcement of federal immigration law.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Brian Lanoue, 45th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPLICABILITY OF GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY IN ACTIONS FILED AGAINST A POLICE OFFICER OR LAW ENFORCEMENT UNIT.
purpose: To allow police officers to assert governmental immunity in more situations and to permit interlocutory appeals of a trial court's denial of the application of the defense of governmental immunity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEFINITION OF CHILD PORNOGRAPHY.
purpose: To bring the child pornography definitions in line with federal language concerning virtual children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNLAWFUL DISSEMINATION OF INTIMATE IMAGES THAT ARE DIGITALLY ALTERED OR CREATED THROUGH THE USE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE.
purpose: To criminalize unauthorized dissemination of intimate images that are digitally altered or created through the use of artificial intelligence.
cosponsors: Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSENT SEARCHES.
purpose: To permit law enforcement officials to conduct a consent search of a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGAL PROTECTIONS FOR CHILDREN IN THE EVENT OF INTIMATE PARTNER HOMICIDE.
purpose: To provide enhanced legal protections for children in the event of intimate partner violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE POSSESSION OF NITROUS OXIDE.
purpose: To protect the public from the harmful effects of nitrous oxide.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT RESTRICTING EARLY RELEASE FOR PERSONS CONVICTED OF CRIMES INVOLVING SEXUAL ASSAULT OR FIREARMS.
purpose: To protect the citizens of Connecticut from early release of convicted violent felons.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSENT SEARCHES OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To permit consent searches of motor vehicles in the same manner as permitted for pedestrians.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING PROHIBITIONS ON NONCOMPETE AGREEMENTS.
purpose: To eliminate existing prohibitions on noncompete provisions in private employment contracts.

primary_sponsors: SEN. JEFF GORDON, 35th DIST.; REP. TIM ACKERT, 8th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL BUS DRIVERS AND THE ABILITY TO STRIKE.
purpose: To prohibit the ability of school bus drivers to strike.
introduced_by: SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.; REP. ACKERT, 8th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DOCUMENTATION FOR THE USE OF PAID SICK LEAVE.
purpose: To allow employers to require documentation that an employee's use of paid sick leave is being taken for a permitted purpose.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. HEATHER S. SOMERS, 18th DIST.; SEN. JEFF GORDON, 35th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PREVAILING WAGE THRESHOLD FOR RENOVATIONS.
purpose: To increase the total cost threshold for renovations of any public works project and to require such threshold to be indexed to reflect inflation.
cosponsors: Sen. Rob Sampson, 16th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SOMERS, 18th Dist.; SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PREVAILING WAGE THRESHOLD.
purpose: To increase the prevailing wage thresholds.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EMPLOYMENT OF MINORS AT LEAST SIXTEEN YEARS OF AGE IN CERTAIN OCCUPATIONS.
purpose: To expand the scope of work that minors sixteen and seventeen years of age can be employed or permitted to work in.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TIME FRAMES FOR BINDING ARBITRATION.
purpose: To amend time frames for binding arbitration in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADEQUATE PRESCRIPTION OF PAIN MEDICATION FOR CANCER PATIENTS, PALLIATIVE AND NURSING HOME PATIENTS AND PATIENTS EXPERIENCING CHRONIC INTRACTABLE PAIN.
purpose: To allow health care practitioners to adequately prescribe pain medication.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.; REP. CHRISTOPHER POULOS, 81st DIST.; REP. DONNA VEACH, 30th DIST.
title: AN ACT ALLOWING MUNICIPALITIES TO SELECT THEIR PRIMARY SERVICE AREA RESPONDER.
purpose: To allow each municipality to select its own primary service area responder.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.; REP. POULOS, 81st Dist.; REP. VEACH, 30th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. JEFF GORDON, 35th DIST.; SEN. HEATHER S. SOMERS, 18th DIST.
title: AN ACT CODIFYING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF THE EMERGENCY MEDICAL TREATMENT AND ACTIVE LABOR ACT.
purpose: To codify certain provisions of the federal Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act concerning emergency health care.
introduced_by: SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.; SEN. SOMERS, 18th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTAL NOTIFICATION PRIOR TO THE TERMINATION OF A PREGNANCY BY A MINOR.
purpose: To ensure that the best interests of a minor are protected when facing an unplanned pregnancy.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE PLANS FOR SINGLE-FAMILY DWELLINGS FROM DISCLOSURE UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To protect the security of single-family dwellings by exempting the plans for such dwellings from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF POLICE POLICIES ON WELLNESS CHECKS.
purpose: To review policies of the State Police and municipal police departments on wellness checks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE STATE'S CURRENT LAWS REGARDING REPEAT OFFENDERS OF LAWS PROHIBITING DRIVING UNDER THE INFLUENCE.
purpose: To study the state's current laws regarding repeat offenders of laws prohibiting driving under the influence in order to protect the public from impaired drivers.
cosponsors: Sen. Saud Anwar, 3rd Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CERTAIN MINIMUM NUMBER OF STATE TROOPERS.
purpose: To establish a minimum number of one thousand two hundred forty-eight state troopers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE STATE FIRE SAFETY CODE RELATING TO METHODS OF EGRESS IN THE EVENT OF AN INTRUDER.
purpose: To study the State Fire Safety Code as it relates to methods of egress in the event of an intruder, including the use of a lock that requires two releasing motions.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS TO CARRY AND TO AUTHORIZE THE USE OF PULSE OXIMETERS.
purpose: To allow law enforcement officers to carry and to authorize the use of pulse oximeters.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE COMMISSIONER OF EMERGENCY SERVICES AND PUBLIC PROTECTION TO ACQUIRE A FEDERAL FIREARMS LICENSE.
purpose: To ensure the Commissioner of Emergency Services and Public Protection facilitates firearm transfers from person to person in compliance with rules established by the federal Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms regarding such transfers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY AND DETERMINE THE BEST MECHANISM FOR PROVIDING NOTICE OF CERTAIN RESTRAINING OR PROTECTIVE ORDERS TO SCHOOL OFFICIALS AND RESOURCE OFFICERS.
purpose: To establish a working group to study and determine the best mechanism for providing the appropriate school official or school resource officer with notice of any restraining or protective order concerning a student or the parent or legal guardian of a student at such official's or officer's school.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEXTING WHILE DRIVING.
purpose: To increase the fines and penalties for someone who causes injury to another person as a result of texting and driving.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPARENCY IN TRANSPORTATION PROJECTS.
purpose: To provide transparency in transportation projects.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN FEDERAL VETERANS' BENEFITS AND INCOME ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATIONS FOR CERTAIN PUBLIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS.
purpose: To disregard from income certain federal veterans' benefits when determining eligibility for certain public assistance programs.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING SERVICE IN TIME OF WAR AS AN ELIGIBILITY CRITERION FOR CERTAIN STATE AND MUNICIPAL VETERANS' BENEFITS.
purpose: To eliminate service in time of war as an eligibility criterion for certain state and municipal veterans' benefits.
cosponsors: Sen. Jeff Gordon, 35th Dist.; Rep. Christopher Poulos, 81st Dist.; Rep. Kurt Vail, 52nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR CERTAIN COMMUNITY SERVICE ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To provide additional funding for United Services, Inc. and youth services in the towns of Chaplin, Hampton and Scotland.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT CRISIS INTERVENTION TEAMS.
purpose: To permanently fund law enforcement crisis intervention teams.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE OFFICE OF DYSLEXIA AND READING DISABILITIES.
purpose: To provide an operating budget for the Office of Dyslexia and Reading Disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF A PENSION BUYOUT PLAN FOR STATE EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To require the Office of Policy Management to study a state employee pension buyout plan.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING TO REIMBURSE MUNICIPALITIES FOR REVENUE LOSS CAUSED BY VETERAN PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS.
purpose: To hold municipalities harmless for granting veterans benefits.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.; Rep. Brian Lanoue, 45th Dist.; Rep. Kurt Vail, 52nd Dist.; Rep. Jaime S. Foster, 57th Dist.; Rep. Tim Ackert, 8th Dist.; Sen. title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO REVIEW POLICIES CONCERNING THE RELEASE OF BALLOONS.
purpose: To create a task force to review policies concerning the release of balloons.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN AUDIT OF UNPAID UTILITY BILLS DUE TO FINANCIAL HARDSHIP.
purpose: To require (1) an audit of shut-off moratoria related to the financial hardship of an end use customer of any utility, and (2) monthly statements from the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority concerning efforts to collect unpaid bills related to such moratoria.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A SUSPENSION OF THE PUBLIC BENEFITS CHARGE, LIMITS ON CERTAIN POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENTS, THE ELIMINATION OF CERTAIN ZERO-CARBON INCENTIVES AND AN INCREASE IN THE NATURAL GAS SUPPLY.
purpose: To (1) suspend the charges collectively called the "Combined Public Benefits Charge" pending legislative review of such charges, (2) prohibit any power purchase agreement that provides for the purchase of electricity at a price exceeding one hundred fifty per cent of the wholesale price of electricity, (3) remove incentives for the development of zero-carbon energy sources unless such incentives are available for the development of any energy generation, and (4) promote an increase in the natural gas supply in the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAPITAL GAINS TAX ON CERTAIN ENDOWMENT FUNDS OF INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION AND CONCERNING THE USE OF THE REVENUE GENERATED.
purpose: To impose a capital gains tax on certain endowment funds of institutions of higher education and dedicate the revenue from such tax to reducing the amount that participants in the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program are required to contribute under section 31-49g of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AGRICULTURAL LABOR REMUNERATION THRESHOLD FOR IMPOSITION OF UNEMPLOYMENT TAXES.
purpose: To increase, for purposes of the imposition of unemployment taxes, the threshold for payments made to individuals employed in agricultural labor in a calendar quarter, from twenty thousand dollars to thirty thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TOUR PROVIDERS AND THE PROVISION OF BASIC LIFE SUPPORT.
purpose: To ensure that certain persons providing tours are trained to provide basic life support.
cosponsors: Rep. Raghib Allie-Brennan, 2nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SKILLED TRADE LICENSING RECIPROCITY, LICENSING FEES AND APPRENTICESHIP RATIOS.
purpose: To provide for licensing reciprocity for skilled tradespersons, cap licensing fees applicable to skilled tradespersons and modify the required apprenticeship ratios applicable to the skilled trades.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS FROM RECEIVING TAXPAYER-FUNDED BENEFITS.
purpose: To reduce the tax burden of lawful residents by prohibiting the state from providing taxpayer-funded benefits and social welfare services to illegal immigrants.
cosponsors: Rep. Kurt Vail, 52nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID AND MEDICARE RATE REIMBURSEMENT PARITY.
purpose: To equalize Medicaid and Medicare reimbursement rates.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR BIOMARKER TESTING.
purpose: To require that individual and group health insurance policies provide coverage for biomarker testing.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH INSURANCE COMPANIES FROM UNILATERALLY LIMITING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR SPECIAL NEEDS CHILDREN.
purpose: To prohibit health insurance companies from unilaterally limiting health insurance coverage for special needs children, including health insurance coverage for physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech pathology and feeding therapy services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CREATION OF A TASK FORCE TO STUDY REFORMS TO THE FAMILY COURT PROCESS.
purpose: To create a task force to study and recommend reforms to the family court process in order to ensure justice and fair outcomes and to reduce the costs to individuals.
cosponsors: Rep. Irene M. Haines, 34th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPENSATION PAID TO JURORS.
purpose: To provide increased compensation to jurors who are required to miss more than five days of work due to jury service.

title: AN ACT CLARIFYING THE APPLICABILITY OF THE PREVAILING WAGE STATUTE.
purpose: To maximize private investment in municipal economic development and affordable housing projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE WRITTEN EXAMINATION FOR BUILDING INSPECTOR LICENSURE.
purpose: To specify that the Department of Administrative Services shall administer the written examination for building inspectors every other month.

title: AN ACT REPEALING A STATUTE CONCERNING PROHIBITED CHARTER AMENDMENTS.
purpose: To repeal a statute concerning prohibited charter amendments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL ASSISTANCE IN COMPLYING WITH REQUIREMENTS RELATED TO STORMWATER DISCHARGE.
purpose: To aid municipalities in compliance with permitting requirements related to the discharge of stormwater from municipal separate storm sewer systems.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGIONAL PLANNING INCENTIVE ACCOUNT DISTRIBUTION FORMULA.
purpose: To change the regional planning incentive account distribution formula by indexing the per capita payment amount to inflation or an amount determined by the General Assembly, provided such amount shall not be decreased.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY REGARDING THE DEFINITION OF "INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY".
purpose: To explore methods of determining intellectual disability other than the intelligence quotient.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN INCREASED NUMBER OF STATE TROOPERS ASSIGNED AS SCHOOL RESOURCE OFFICERS AT VOCATIONAL-TECHNICAL SCHOOLS.
purpose: To require that an increased number of state troopers be assigned as school resource officers at vocational-technical schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POLICE OFFICER DISCRETION TO PURSUE MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To provide discretion to a police officer to pursue a motor vehicle if such officer can articulate a public safety need for such pursuit.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE BARRIERS TO MEDICAL PROFESSIONALS BECOMING VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS OR VOLUNTEER EMERGENCY MEDICAL TECHNICIANS.
purpose: To address the shortage of volunteer firefighters and volunteer emergency medical technicians.

title: AN ACT LOWERING THE COST OF RESIDENT STATE TROOPERS FOR MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To lower the cost of resident state troopers for municipalities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MINIMUM NUMBER OF SWORN STATE POLICE PERSONNEL.
purpose: To protect public safety by ensuring appropriate staffing levels within the state police force.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NEW PILOT PROGRAM TO TEST ON-DEMAND MICROTRANSIT SERVICES IN THE COUNTIES OF WINDHAM AND TOLLAND.
purpose: To establish and fund a new pilot program to test on-demand microtransit services in rural areas not currently served by public transportation.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING ANTI-ISRAELI BOYCOTT, DIVESTMENT AND SANCTIONS.
purpose: To ban anti-Israeli BDS (Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions) in state and local pensions, state contracts and publicly funded post-secondary education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR AFFORDABLE AND SUPPORTIVE HOUSING.
purpose: To invest in affordable and supportive housing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INVESTMENT IN SUPPORTIVE HOUSING AND HOME OWNERSHIP INITIATIVES.
purpose: To promote investments in supportive housing initiatives and home ownership support initiatives.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR SIGN LANGUAGE INTERPRETER SERVICES AT ALCOHOLICS ANONYMOUS AND NARCOTICS ANONYMOUS MEETINGS.
purpose: To promote inclusivity and equal access to addiction recovery services in alignment with the state's commitment to support public health and enhance accessibility for individuals with disabilities.
cosponsors: Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AT THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT A CENTER OF EXCELLENCE FOR NEUROMODULATION TREATMENTS FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To establish at The University of Connecticut a Center of Excellence for Neuromodulation Treatments for Veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR RESTORATION OF THE HISTORIC PINNEY HOUSE IN THE TOWN OF ELLINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding for essential restoration and conservation work on, and the development of educational exhibits at, the historic Pinney House in the town of Ellington.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PUBLIC HEALTH URGENT COMMUNICATION FUND.
purpose: To provide funding for clear and rapid dissemination of urgent health information to the members of the general public, health care providers and other stakeholders.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EMERGENCY PUBLIC HEALTH FINANCIAL SAFEGUARD FUND.
purpose: To establish a fund to act as a financial safety net to address unexpected shortfalls in public health funding and ensure the Department of Public Health's ability to respond to the health care needs of state residents and provide a continuity of essential public health services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE ELDERLY NUTRITION PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide funding to ensure the continuation and expansion of the elderly nutrition program and provide nutritious meals, social engagement and community support to senior citizens.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEARN HERE, LIVE HERE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the annual expenditure on the Learn Here, Live Here program to not more than five million dollars and to make such program available only to individuals whose income is seventy-five thousand dollars or less.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERMIT REQUIREMENTS FOR CLOUD SEEDING ACTIVITIES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To protect public safety, health and the environment from any unreasonably risky weather modification activities.
cosponsors: Sen. Jeff Gordon, 35th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO ASSESS AND IMPLEMENT INFRASTRUCTURE RESILIENCY TO CLIMATE CHANGE IN THE GREATER HARTFORD AREA SURROUNDING THE CONNECTICUT RIVER.
purpose: To address infrastructure issues in the Greater Hartford area surrounding the Connecticut River to account for climate change resiliency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FEDERAL FUNDING TO PAY CERTAIN SYSTEMS BENEFITS CHARGES.
purpose: To allocate funding received by the state under the American Rescue Plan Act for the purpose of paying systems benefits charges accrued by electric distribution companies in connection with hardship protection measures during the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MORATORIA AND NOISE AUDITS FOR COMMERCIAL SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC FACILITIES.
purpose: To (1) allow municipalities with three or more existing commercial solar photovoltaic facilities located within such municipality to impose a moratorium on the construction or installation of such facilities within such municipality, (2) allow municipalities to conduct noise audits and impose penalties for noise violations at commercial solar photovoltaic facilities, and (3) require that any developer, owner or manager of a commercial solar photovoltaic facility provide a community point of contact concerning the operation of such facility.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMPOSITION OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY.
purpose: To (1) require that the Public Utility Regulatory Authority be composed of not fewer than five members, one of whom has personal experience with a disability and one of whom with an annual income less than the state median income, and (2) to prohibit current or former employees of, or current or former lobbyists for, any public utility company in the state from serving on the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TECHNICAL SUPPORT FOR MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC UTILITIES AND ESTABLISHING THE MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC UTILITY INVESTMENT FUND.
purpose: To (1) create an office within the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to provide technical and operational support for any municipality that has established or seeks to establish a municipal electric utility, and (2) establish the Municipal Utility Investment Fund to provide grants or low-interest loans to municipalities that seek to acquire, build, expand or improve municipal electric utility infrastructure.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROHIBITION ON PUBLICLY TRADED UTILITY COMPANIES.
purpose: To prohibit the stock of any public utility company from being traded on a stock exchange.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REVIEW OF POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENTS WITH NUCLEAR POWER GENERATING FACILITIES.
purpose: To amend the general statutes to allow the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to (1) review the terms of any power purchase agreement entered into or approved by the commissioner and a nuclear power generating facility on or before July 1, 2024, (2) require the disclosure of any contracts or other financial arrangements entered into by a nuclear power generating facility incidental to such power purchase agreement, and (3) withdraw from, or withdraw approval for, any such agreement if the commissioner determines that a disproportionate amount of funds paid to a nuclear power generating facility pursuant to such agreement are being used for capital projects or other expenses outside the state or if such withdrawal is in the best interest of residents of the state.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCOUNTABILITY FOR HOSPITAL TAX DELINQUENTS.
purpose: To safeguard state tax revenues, promote fiscal responsibility and uphold the equitable distribution of Medicaid funds for public benefit.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR CERTAIN PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS.
purpose: To increase the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension and annuity income and distributions from individual retirement accounts.
cosponsors: Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TAX RATES OF TOBACCO AND NICOTINE PRODUCTS.
purpose: To align the tax rates of combustible and noncombustible tobacco and nicotine products to promote uniformity in the tax treatment of such products.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; SEN. JEFF GORDON, 35th DIST.
title: AN ACT RESTORING THE RATE OF THE CREDIT AGAINST THE AFFECTED BUSINESS ENTITY TAX.
purpose: To restore the rate of the credit against the affected business entity tax to ninety-three and one-hundredths per cent.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX ON CERTAIN POLITICAL COMMITTEES AND CANDIDATE COMMITTEES.
purpose: To establish a tax on political committees and candidate committees that raise and spend funds in the state and to dedicate the revenue generated from such tax to the support of the Citizens' Election Program and other elections-related endeavors.

primary_sponsors: SEN. SAUD ANWAR, 3rd DIST.; REP. JOSH ELLIOTT, 88th DIST.; SEN. CECI MAHER, 26th DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN CONDUCT CONCERNING DRUGS AND MEDICAL DEVICES USED TO EXECUTE THE DEATH PENALTY.
purpose: To provide that certain persons who are licensed, registered or doing business in this state shall not manufacture, compound, sell, test, distribute, dispense or supply any drug or medical device for the purpose of executing the death penalty.
cosponsors: Rep. Laurie Sweet, 91st Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. ANWAR, 3rd Dist.; REP. ELLIOTT, 88th Dist.; SEN. MAHER, 26th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR CONTAINERS TO DISPLAY CANCER RISK WARNING LABELS.

purpose: To require the State Elections Enforcement Commission to advise of defects in contributions in applications for Citizens' Election Program grants and to afford campaign treasurers opportunities to cure such defects or return contributions to contributors.

purpose: To reinstate the Program Review and Investigations Committee and require the Auditors of Public Accounts to conduct performance audits of state agencies for efficiency, effectiveness, performance and compliance.

purpose: To allow a landlord to seek reimbursement for the cost of storing an evicted tenant's personal property.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS TO OPERATE UNDER THE SAME PROCEDURES AS OTHER ADMINISTRATIVE AGENCIES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require a fair rent commission to operate under the same procedures as other administrative agencies in the state.

purpose: To repeal certain provisions of public act 20-1 of the July special session concerning the conduct and actions of police and public safety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSFER OF CERTAIN JUVENILE CASES TO ADULT COURT.
purpose: To allow for transfer of certain juvenile cases.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PREVAILING WAGE FOR NEW CONSTRUCTION AND RENOVATIONS.
purpose: To increase the prevailing wage thresholds for new construction and renovations on any public works project.

purpose: To make various changes to the Connecticut Retirement Security Program.

title: AN ACT MAKING THE CONNECTICUT PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE INSURANCE PROGRAM AN OPT-IN PROGRAM.
purpose: To make the Connecticut Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program an opt-in program.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

purpose: To eliminate the requirement that employers provide paid sick leave to employees in the event of closure by order of a public official.

cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

purpose: To require the audit of same-day election registrations and subsequent confirmation notices of such registrations.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

purpose: To provide that absentee ballot applications that have been completed and signed are public records subject to public inspection.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

purpose: To provide for the adoption of a reciprocal skilled trade licensing agreement with other New England states.
cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.; Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING GROCERY STORE BEER PERMITTEES TO SELL HARD CIDER.
purpose: To authorize grocery store beer permittees to sell hard cider for off-premises consumption.

purpose: To require the Department of Consumer Protection to establish a single uniform business permit and license application without modifying any fee or cost currently imposed for a business permit, license or any application required therefor.

purpose: To increase the minimum average commission payable to lottery sales agents.

purpose: To permit the town of Newtown to use a parcel of land conveyed by the state and located at 6 Commerce Drive in the town of Newtown for open space and recreational purposes.
introduced_by: SEN. HWANG, 28th Dist.; REP. BOLINSKY, 106th Dist.; REP. FONCELLO, 107th Dist.

cosponsors: Rep. Craig C. Fishbein, 90th Dist.; Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.

purpose: To establish quarterly meetings between the Commissioner of Social Services and providers, including durable medical equipment providers, to address Medicaid reimbursement rates and develop solutions to improve access to critical medical equipment and other health services for Medicaid beneficiaries.

purpose: To require that each affordable housing development be not greater than four stories.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A NOTIFICATION OF RIGHTS TO PARTIES BEFORE A FAIR RENT COMMISSION.
purpose: To require that a fair rent commission notify parties of their rights and the scope of such commission's lawful authority.

cosponsors: Rep. Travis Simms, 140th Dist.

purpose: To establish a task force to study ways of providing expedited recourse to homeowners who incur property damage caused by those visiting, or residing in, an abutting group home.

purpose: To expedite access to justice for those claiming discrimination and harassment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CANCELLATION OF TELECOMMUNICATIONS SERVICES.
purpose: To provide that (1) a consumer may cancel any telecommunications service during a billing cycle, and (2) in the event of any such cancellation, the telecommunications company providing such service shall (A) not charge the consumer for any period following such cancellation, and (B) provide a pro rata rebate to the consumer for any prepaid telecommunications service.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING REDACTION FEES FOR THE DISCLOSURE OF RECORDS CREATED BY POLICE BODY-WORN RECORDING EQUIPMENT OR DASHBOARD CAMERAS UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To authorize a public agency to charge a fee for the redaction of certain records created by police body-worn recording equipment or dashboard cameras as authorized under state or federal law prior to disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act.
cosponsors: Sen. Sujata Gadkar-Wilcox, 22nd Dist.; Rep. Jill Barry, 31st Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF STATE AGENCY RESPONSE TIMES TO FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT REQUESTS.
purpose: To study state agency response times to requests under the Freedom of Information Act and submit a report concerning such study to ensure that such responses are timely.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W. Anderson, 62nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONVEYING A PARCEL OF STATE LAND IN THE TOWN OF CHESHIRE TO THE TOWN OF CHESHIRE.
purpose: To convey a parcel of state land located in the town of Cheshire to the town of Cheshire for purposes of parking and driveway expansion.
cosponsors: Rep. Jonathan Fazzino, 83rd Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. MAE FLEXER, 29th DIST.; REP. PATRICK S. BOYD, 50th DIST.
title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE BOARD OF REGENTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To eliminate the Board of Regents for Higher Education and reinstate the Board of Trustees for Community Colleges and a Board of Trustees for State Universities.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. FLEXER, 29th Dist.; REP. BOYD, 50th Dist.

primary_sponsors: Higher Education and Employment Advancement Committee
title: AN ACT PROTECTING PARTICIPANTS IN TITLE IX PROCEEDINGS AT INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To provide immunity from liability for students and employees of institutions of higher education who report or disclose being a victim of sexual assault, stalking or intimate partner violence and participate or testify in any Title IX investigation or proceedings.
cosponsors: Sen. Mae Flexer, 29th Dist.; Rep. Gregory Haddad, 54th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. FLEXER, 29th Dist.; REP. HADDAD, 54th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CAFETERIAS ON THE CAMPUSES OF CONNECTICUT STATE COMMUNITY COLLEGE.
purpose: To require the Connecticut State Community College to maintain a functioning cafeteria on each campus.

primary_sponsors: SEN. MAE FLEXER, 29th DIST.; REP. PATRICK S. BOYD, 50th DIST.
title: AN ACT ALLOWING LEARNING IN RETIREMENT PROGRAMS AT CONNECTICUT STATE COMMUNITY COLLEGE CAMPUSES.
purpose: To require the Connecticut State Community College to allow Learning in Retirement programs to operate on the campuses of said college.
cosponsors: Rep. Anne Dauphinais, 44th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. FLEXER, 29th Dist.; REP. BOYD, 50th Dist.

primary_sponsors: Higher Education and Employment Advancement Committee
title: AN ACT IMPROVING SAFETY ON THE CAMPUSES OF INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To require institutions of higher education to provide training and adopt procedures to respond to and prevent incidents of hate, harassment and racial, religious or ethnic bias.
cosponsors: Sen. Matthew L. Lesser, 9th Dist.; Rep. Aundre Bumgardner, 41st Dist.; Rep. Steve Weir, 55th Dist.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING MEDICAID ELIGIBILITY FOR OLDER PERSONS AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To expand access to Medicaid by disregarding certain income in determining eligibility of disabled adult children.
cosponsors: Sen. Catherine A. Osten, 19th Dist.; Rep. Geraldo C. Reyes, 75th Dist.; Rep. Eleni Kavros DeGraw, 17th Dist.; Sen. Paul Honig, 8th Dist.; Rep. Kaitlyn Shake, 120th Dist.; Rep. Sarah Keitt, 134th Dist.; Rep. Patricia A. Dillon, 92nd Dist.; Rep. Mike Demicco, 21st Dist.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE REQUIREMENT THAT MEDICAID AND HUSKY B COVER WEIGHT LOSS DRUGS AND BARIATRIC SURGERY.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that prescription weight loss drugs and bariatric surgery be covered for Medicaid and HUSKY B beneficiaries.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RATIO OF SOCIAL SERVICES, MENTAL HEALTH AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE STATE AND PRIVATE NONPROFIT PROVIDERS.
purpose: To study the ratio of certain services provided by the state and nonprofit providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENT PARITY FOR DENTAL SERVICES FUNDED UNDER THE HUSKY HEALTH PROGRAM.
purpose: To achieve parity in payments for dental services under the HUSKY Health program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR CHANGES TO THE HUSKY HEALTH PROGRAM REIMBURSEMENT AND CARE DELIVERY MODEL.
purpose: To require legislative approval for changes to the HUSKY Health program reimbursement and care delivery model.
cosponsors: Sen. Martin M. Looney, 11th Dist.; Sen. Saud Anwar, 3rd Dist.; Sen. Matthew L. Lesser, 9th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPANDING ACCESS TO STATE-FUNDED ASSISTED LIVING SERVICES.
purpose: To expand access to state-funded assisted living services to allow senior citizens to age in place and save state funds spent on skilled nursing facility care.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX ON CERTAIN UNOCCUPIED RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To establish a tax on certain unoccupied residential property.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING RULES FOR NO-FAULT EVICTIONS.
purpose: To establish rules for no-fault evictions and exceptions for such evictions.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO FUND AFFORDABLE AND WORKFORCE HOUSING DEVELOPMENT IN CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To provide funding for affordable and workforce housing development in certain municipalities that have not met the threshold for exemption from the affordable housing appeals procedure.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY AND DEVELOP BEST PRACTICES TO PROMOTE HOUSING GROWTH AND PROTECT THE STATE'S WATER SUPPLY.
purpose: To establish a working group to study and develop best practices to promote housing growth and protect the state's water supply and report on such working group's findings.

primary_sponsors: SEN. CHRISTINE COHEN, 12th DIST.; SEN. JORGE CABRERA, 17th DIST.; REP. CHRIS ANISKOVICH, 35th DIST.
title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAP FOR ANNUAL RENT INCREASES IN MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOME PARKS.
purpose: To cap annual rent increases in mobile manufactured home parks.
introduced_by: SEN. COHEN, 12th Dist.; SEN. CABRERA, 17th Dist.; REP. ANISKOVICH, 35th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY MUNICIPAL PENALTIES FOR LANDLORDS FOR HEALTH AND SAFETY VIOLATIONS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study municipal penalties for landlords for health and safety violations and determine other mechanisms to resolve such violations that encourage appropriate repairs and ensure tenants have habitable housing.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING A HOUSING PROVIDER FROM CONSIDERING A PROSPECTIVE TENANT'S FELONY CONVICTION RECORD AFTER A CERTAIN TIME PERIOD.
purpose: To prohibit a housing provider from considering a prospective tenant's felony conviction record after a certain time period.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING BIPARTISAN MEMBERSHIP OF FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To require that the membership of each municipal fair rent commission be bipartisan and consist of landlords who own property in such municipality and tenants who reside in such municipality.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE EVICTION OF A RESIDENTIAL TENANT FOR NONPAYMENT OF RENT IF THE LANDLORD'S ONLINE RENTAL PAYMENT SYSTEM PREVENTS SUCH PAYMENT OF RENT.
purpose: To prohibit a landlord from evicting a tenant for nonpayment of rent if the landlord's online rental payment system prevents the tenant from paying such rent.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING EVICTION FOR LAPSE OF TIME OF CERTAIN TENANTS.
purpose: To prohibit an eviction for lapse of time for tenants residing in a property containing five or more dwelling units.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT CERTAIN EVICTION RECORDS BE SEALED.
purpose: To require that certain eviction records be sealed.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR MEDICAL FOODS FOR INDIVIDUALS DIAGNOSED WITH PHENYLKETONURIA.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for medical foods for individuals diagnosed with phenylketonuria.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR MOTORIZED WHEELCHAIRS.
purpose: To: (1) Require health insurance coverage for (A) motorized wheelchairs, including, but not limited to, used motorized wheelchairs, requested by insureds, (B) motorized wheelchair repairs, and (C) motorized wheelchair battery replacements; and (2) require health insurers to establish centralized locations to collect used motorized wheelchairs.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR CERTAIN OBESITY TREATMENTS.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide coverage for certain obesity treatments, including, but not limited to, bariatric surgery.
cosponsors: Sen. Eric C. Berthel, 32nd Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF STOP LOSS INSURANCE.
purpose: To (1) increase the attachment point for stop loss insurance policies for certain self-insured small businesses, and (2) require the Insurance Commissioner to report on the feasibility of implementing a minimum loss ratio and other consumer protections for stop loss insurance.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MEDICAL LOSS RATIO FOR DENTAL INSURANCE.
purpose: To establish the same medical loss ratio for dental insurance that exists for medical insurance.
cosponsors: Sen. Martin M. Looney, 11th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A DENTAL LOSS RATIO.
purpose: To: (1) Establish a dental loss ratio of not less than eighty-three per cent for any dental insurance policy issued in this state; (2) require any dental insurer that fails to satisfy such dental loss ratio to issue rebates to covered persons of an amount that results in such dental insurer satisfying such dental loss ratio; and (3) establish expenditure reporting requirements for dental insurers, including an evaluation of the proportion of funds allocated to patient care versus administrative costs, marketing costs and profits.
cosponsors: Rep. Tom Delnicki, 14th Dist.; Sen. Martin M. Looney, 11th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPLIANCE WITH MENTAL HEALTH PARITY LAWS.
purpose: To: (1) Require the Insurance Department to conduct regular audits of health insurance companies to ensure compliance with the Paul Wellstone and Pete Domenici Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act of 2008, P.L. 110-343, as amended from time to time, and regulations adopted thereunder, and the mental health parity laws and regulations in this state; and (2) establish a civil penalty of fifty thousand dollars per incident for any health insurance company that fails to comply with federal or state mental health parity laws and regulations.

primary_sponsors: SEN. MAE FLEXER, 29th DIST.; REP. GREGORY HADDAD, 54th DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF GEOGRAPHIC LOCATION AS A FACTOR IN DETERMINING PREMIUM RATES.
purpose: To prohibit any insurance company from using geographic location as a factor in determining premium rates.
introduced_by: SEN. FLEXER, 29th Dist.; REP. HADDAD, 54th Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING IN-NETWORK RATES DURING HEALTH INSURANCE CONTRACT DISPUTES.
purpose: To require any health insurance contract between a health carrier and a hospital to include provisions providing for continued treatment for covered persons from in-network providers at the in-network rate, including, but not limited to, cost-sharing, during disputes between such health carrier and hospital.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR EARLY CHILD CARE WORKERS.
purpose: To allow any early child care worker to obtain health insurance coverage under the state employee health plan.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR NONPROFITS UNDER THE STATE EMPLOYEE HEALTH PLAN.
purpose: To allow any nonprofit to obtain health insurance coverage under the state employee health plan.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE REMOVAL OF PARTICIPATING PROVIDERS UNTIL THE END OF A POLICY PERIOD.
purpose: To prohibit participating providers from being removed from any covered person's network during a health insurance policy period.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BURDEN OF PROOF DURING ADVERSE DETERMINATION AND UTILIZATION REVIEW.
purpose: To establish a rebuttable presumption that health carriers shall bear the burden of proving that certain health care services under adverse determination or utilization review are not medically necessary.
cosponsors: Sen. Saud Anwar, 3rd Dist.

title: AN ACT REGULATING REBATES BY PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGERS.
purpose: To require that (1) pharmacy benefits managers' rebates are calculated at the point of sale based on the net price of the prescription drug, and (2) pharmacy benefits managers certify compliance with the Insurance Department.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CONTRACTS BETWEEN PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGERS AND HEALTH CARRIERS TO PROVIDE FEE-BASED COMPENSATION.
purpose: To require that any contract between a health carrier and a pharmacy benefits manager provide fee-based compensation that shall not be connected to the price of the prescription drug, any rebate, premiums or cost-sharing.

primary_sponsors: SEN. JEFF GORDON, 35th DIST.; REP. COREY P. PARIS, 145th DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR CLOSURE OF A PATENT FORAMEN OVALE.
purpose: To require that all individual and group health insurance policies provide health insurance coverage for the medical procedure for the closure of a patent foramen ovale.
introduced_by: SEN. GORDON, 35th Dist.; REP. PARIS, 145th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INVESTIGATIONS OF EXECUTIVE BOARDS AND PROPERTY MANAGERS OF COMMON INTEREST COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To (1) provide the Department of Consumer Protection and the Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities with the ability to investigate any complaint that an executive board or property manager of a common interest community is violating (A) the civil rights of residents of such common interest community, or (B) conflict of interest rules, and (2) require that the conduct of any executive board of a common interest community may constitute state action for civil rights purposes.

primary_sponsors: SEN. DEREK SLAP, 5th DIST.; SEN. MARTIN M. LOONEY, 11th DIST.; REP. MIKE DEMICCO, 21st DIST.; REP. LAURIE SWEET, 91st DIST.
title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC PROSTHETIC AND ORTHOTIC DEVICES.
purpose: To require that all individual and group health insurance policies provide health insurance coverage for activity-specific prosthetic and orthotic devices.
cosponsors: Rep. Rebecca Martinez, 22nd Dist.; Rep. Steven Winter, 94th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SLAP, 5th Dist.; SEN. LOONEY, 11th Dist.; REP. DEMICCO, 21st Dist.; REP. SWEET, 91st Dist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT TO CONDUCT A STUDY OF CERTAIN HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE PRACTICES.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Department (1) conduct a study of homeowners insurance practices that require policyholders to make repairs or modifications to such policyholders' residential properties as a condition of granting or maintaining coverage, and (2) submit a report by January 1, 2026, on the findings of such study and provide recommendations to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PENALTY FOR ASSAULTING A COACH.
purpose: To promote safety of coaches in youth sports, thus promoting the safety of those promoting team sports and sportsmanship.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN APPLICATION BY A TRIBE TO CONVERT A PARCEL OF FEE INTEREST LAND TO FEDERAL TRUST STATUS.
purpose: To remove the mandate that the Attorney General oppose any application by a tribe to convert any parcel of fee interest land to federal trust status.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF FROZEN EMBRYOS.
purpose: To authorize the adoption of frozen embryos.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSIDERATION OF GEOGRAPHIC FACTORS WHEN DETERMINING THE LOCATION FOR A PERSON'S JURY SERVICE.
purpose: To require that a potential juror's geographic proximity to the location of a courthouse be a factor in determining where the jury service is to occur, taking into consideration that a potential juror's place of residence may be in closer geographic proximity to a courthouse located in a different judicial district.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIABILITY FOR AGRICULTURAL OPERATIONS ENGAGED IN AGRITOURISM.
purpose: To recognize the inherent risks in participating in agritourism activities and limit the liability of agricultural operators engaged in agritourism in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROPOSED RELOCATION OF A PROBATE COURT.
purpose: To improve access to services offered by a Probate Court, especially for services needed by children, by requiring that any change of location for a Probate Court be approved by all of the municipalities comprising the probate district.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE FEES THAT MAY BE CHARGED BY A NOTARY PUBLIC.
purpose: To increase the statutory fee for the performance of a notarial act from a fee of not exceeding five dollars to a fee of not exceeding ten dollars.

title: AN ACT IMPOSING FINES AGAINST PERSONS WHO PARTICIPATE IN MARRIAGE FRAUD.
purpose: To prevent knowing and wilful immigration and marriage fraud.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING DISCRIMINATION IN THE PROVISION OF HEALTH CARE SERVICES.
purpose: To prevent discrimination in health care.
cosponsors: Rep. Eleni Kavros DeGraw, 17th Dist.; Sen. Paul Honig, 8th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. HENRI MARTIN, 31st DIST.; SEN. PATRICIA BILLIE MILLER, 27th DIST.; REP. ROBERT SANCHEZ, 25th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PRESUMPTION OF JOINT CUSTODY AND EQUAL SHARED PARENTING TIME IN MATTERS INVOLVING THE CARE AND CUSTODY OF A MINOR CHILD.
purpose: To create a rebuttable presumption of joint custody and equal shared parenting time in matters involving the care and custody of a minor child.
introduced_by: SEN. MARTIN, 31st Dist.; SEN. MILLER P., 27th Dist.; REP. SANCHEZ R., 25th Dist.

title: AN ACT REMOVING THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE STATE OPPOSE APPLICATIONS BY FEDERALLY RECOGNIZED INDIAN TRIBES TO CONVERT ANY PARCEL OF FEE INTEREST LAND TO FEDERAL TRUST STATUS.
purpose: To remove the requirement that the state oppose any application by a federally recognized Indian tribe to convert any parcel of fee interest land to federal trust status.
cosponsors: Sen. Catherine A. Osten, 19th Dist.; Rep. Anthony L. Nolan, 39th Dist.; Rep. Aundre Bumgardner, 41st Dist.; Rep. Travis Simms, 140th Dist.; Sen. Patricia Billie Miller, 27th Dist.; Rep. Joshua M. Hall, 7th Dist.; Rep. Trenee McGee, 116th Dist.; Rep. Emmanuel Sanchez, 24th Dist.; Rep. Farley Santos, 109th Dist.; Rep. Geraldo C. Reyes, 75th Dist.; Rep. Derell Wilson, 46th Dist.; Sen. Gary A. Winfield, 10th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION BENEFITS FOR CERTAIN MENTAL OR EMOTIONAL IMPAIRMENTS.
purpose: To allow employees to receive workers' compensation benefits for mental or emotional impairments related to an employee's employment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION BENEFITS FOR FIREFIGHTERS AND OTHER WORKERS IMPACTED BY SIMILAR CONDITIONS THAT ARE DIAGNOSED WITH CANCER.
purpose: To create a presumption that a firefighter's diagnosis of cancer arose out of and in the course of employment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BREASTFEEDING IN THE WORKPLACE.
purpose: To align state and federal law regarding break periods for the purpose of breastfeeding during the work day.
cosponsors: Sen. Jan Hochadel, 13th Dist.; Sen. Gary A. Winfield, 10th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FULL EMPLOYMENT TRUST FUND.
purpose: To create a Full Employment Trust Fund to be administered by the Labor Department.

primary_sponsors: SEN. MAE FLEXER, 29th DIST.; REP. GREGORY HADDAD, 54th DIST.
title: AN ACT EXPANDING PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE TO ALL EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To expand the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program to include all employees, including those under collective bargaining agreements.
introduced_by: SEN. FLEXER, 29th Dist.; REP. HADDAD, 54th Dist.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; REP. ANNE DAUPHINAIS, 44th DIST.; REP. GALE L. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th DIST.
title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE STATE FROM INQUIRING ABOUT THE SINCERITY OF A STATE EMPLOYEE'S RELIGIOUS BELIEFS WHEN REQUESTING A RELIGIOUS EXEMPTION TO A VACCINE MANDATE.
purpose: To prohibit the state from inquiring about the sincerity of a state employee's religious beliefs when requesting a religious exemption to a vaccine mandate.
cosponsors: Rep. Mark W Anderson, 62nd Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; REP. DAUPHINAIS, 44th Dist.; REP. MASTROFRANCESCO, 80th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYEE EXPOSURE TO THE RISK OF HEAT ILLNESS.
purpose: To protect workers from exposure to the risk of heat illness.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIMITATIONS ON THE USE OF NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENTS.
purpose: To limit the misuse of nondisclosure agreements by adopting similar provisions from California, New Jersey and Washington law regarding limitations on the use of nondisclosure agreements.
cosponsors: Sen. Mae Flexer, 29th Dist.; Rep. Matt Blumenthal, 147th Dist.; Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.
introduced_by: SEN. FLEXER, 29th Dist.; REP. BLUMENTHAL, 147th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING DISCLOSURES FOR JOB POSTINGS AND EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To establish disclosures similar to Colorado's equal pay law to ensure pay transparency and eliminate wage disparities.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PER DIEM RATE FOR MEMBERS OF THE STATE BOARD OF LABOR RELATIONS AND COMPENSATION FOR MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF MEDIATION AND ARBITRATION.
purpose: To increase the per diem rate for regular and alternate members of the State Board of Labor Relations.
cosponsors: Sen. Jorge Cabrera, 17th Dist.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING MUNICIPALITIES FROM IMPOSING RESTRICTIONS ON OR TAKING ADVERSE ACTION AGAINST ANY PERSON WHO REPORTS A SUSPECTED FRAUDULENT MARRIAGE TO UNITED STATES CITIZENSHIP AND IMMIGRATION SERVICES.
purpose: To prohibit municipalities from (1) restricting any person from reporting a suspected fraudulent marriage to United States Citizenship and Immigration Services, or (2) taking adverse action against any such person for making any such report.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DATES OF ADOPTION OF STATE, REGIONAL AND MUNICIPAL PLANS OF CONSERVATION AND DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To require adoption of the state, regional and municipal plans of conservation and development on March 1, 2030, March 1, 2031, and March 1, 2032, respectively, and every ten years thereafter.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING MUNICIPALITIES TO ISSUE BONDS FOR ENERGY GRID MODERNIZATION PROJECTS.
purpose: To allow a municipality to issue bonds for the purpose of investment in energy grid modernization projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VOLUNTARY REVENUE SHARING AGREEMENTS BETWEEN CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To permit certain municipalities to adopt variable mill rates in consultation with one or more municipalities located in the same geographic region in order to facilitate voluntary revenue sharing agreements.

primary_sponsors: SEN. CATHERINE A. OSTEN, 19th DIST.; REP. ANTHONY L. NOLAN, 39th DIST.; REP. DERELL WILSON, 46th DIST.
title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION FOR PROPERTY LOCATED ON CERTAIN INDIAN LANDS.
purpose: To establish a property tax exemption for real property and tangible personal property located on certain Indian lands.
introduced_by: SEN. OSTEN, 19th Dist.; REP. NOLAN, 39th Dist.; REP. WILSON, 46th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STRENGTHENING SERVICES FOR PERSONS WITH AN INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY.
purpose: To address concerns of aging parents of children with an intellectual disability.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADVERSE DETERMINATION AND UTILIZATION REVIEWS.
purpose: To require health carriers to bear the burden of proving that certain health care services under adverse determination or utilization review are not medically necessary.

primary_sponsors: SEN. STEPHEN G. HARDING, 30th DIST.; SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; SEN. HEATHER S. SOMERS, 18th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING SURGERY ON MINORS.
purpose: To ensure that the best interests of minors are protected when experiencing gender dysphoria or incongruence.
introduced_by: SEN. HARDING, 30th Dist.; SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; SEN. SOMERS, 18th Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY HOME HEALTH SERVICES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To study home health services in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CERTIFICATION OF HOME HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS WHO PROVIDE BEHAVIORAL HEALTH SERVICES.
purpose: To require home health care providers of behavioral health services be certified to provide such services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH CARE ACCESS AND AFFORDABILITY.
purpose: To expand affordable, accessible and quality health care to all state residents.

primary_sponsors: SEN. JULIE KUSHNER, 24th DIST.; REP. AIMEE BERGER-GIRVALO, 111th DIST.
title: AN ACT PROVIDING TELEHEALTH ACCESS TO STATE RESIDENTS WHILE OUT OF STATE.
purpose: To provide telehealth access to state residents while out of state.
introduced_by: SEN. KUSHNER, 24th Dist.; REP. BERGER -GIRVALO, 111th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE'S PARTICIPATION IN THE INTERSTATE MEDICAL LICENSURE COMPACT.
purpose: To enable participation in and ensure compliance with the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact.

title: AN ACT INCREASING COMPENSATION FOR AND ADDRESSING DISPARITIES AFFECTING DIRECT SERVICE PROVIDERS CARING FOR THE INTELLECTUALLY AND DEVELOPMENTALLY DISABLED.
purpose: To address the economic and racial inequities facing direct service providers by increasing state funding to improve wages and strengthen the workforce that supports the state's intellectually and developmentally disabled residents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SCOPE OF PRACTICE OF OCCUPATIONAL THERAPISTS AND OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY ASSISTANTS.
purpose: To update and modernize the scope of practice for occupational therapists and occupational therapy assistants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE IMPROVEMENT OF HOME HEALTH CARE SERVICES DELIVERY.
purpose: To implement certain policies that would improve the delivery of home health care services across the state.

primary_sponsors: SEN. ROB SAMPSON, 16th DIST.; SEN. RYAN FAZIO, 36th DIST.
title: AN ACT FACILITATING STATE LICENSURE OF INTERNATIONAL MEDICAL GRADUATES.
purpose: To address physician shortages by making it easier for qualified and experienced foreign-trained medical doctors who lawfully migrate to the United States to become licensed to practice medicine in Connecticut.
introduced_by: SEN. SAMPSON, 16th Dist.; SEN. FAZIO, 36th Dist.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF MEDICAL DEVICE REPRESENTATIVES.
purpose: To establish the role and responsibilities of medical device representatives who set up and attend surgical procedures.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING DENTISTS TRAINED OUTSIDE THE UNITED STATES TO BE LICENSED DENTAL HYGIENISTS.
purpose: To increase the workforce supply of dental hygienists in Connecticut to ensure essential oral health care for our citizens by utilizing the skills that dentists have acquired through training outside of the United States.

primary_sponsors: SEN. HEATHER S. SOMERS, 18th DIST.; SEN. SAUD ANWAR, 3rd DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE PORTABILITY AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT REQUIREMENTS AND ELECTRONIC HEALTH RECORDS SYSTEMS AND THE MODERNIZATION OF MEDICAL RECORD FEES.
purpose: To update the medical records statutes.
introduced_by: SEN. SOMERS, 18th Dist.; SEN. ANWAR, 3rd Dist.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING LICENSURE FOR REFLEXOLOGISTS.
purpose: To establish licensure for reflexologists.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING CERTAIN NURSE'S AIDES AND ASSISTED LIVING AIDES TO ADMINISTER MEDICATION TO NURSING HOME RESIDENTS AND ASSISTED LIVING SERVICES AGENCY CLIENTS.
purpose: To improve and expand staffing in nursing homes and assisted living settings.

primary_sponsors: SEN. SAUD ANWAR, 3rd DIST.; SEN. HEATHER S. SOMERS, 18th DIST.
title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTIFICATE OF NEED APPLICATIONS FOR SMALL PHYSICIAN-OWNED MEDICAL GROUPS.

purpose: To require the Commissioner of Health Strategy to study (1) whether to exclude patient health information and medical records relating to certain sensitive medical procedures from the State-wide Health Information Exchange, and (2) current procedures relating to patient participation in the State-wide Health Information Exchange.

purpose: To prohibit private equity companies and real estate investment trusts from acquiring or increasing (1) any direct or indirect ownership interest in a nursing home, and (2) any operational or financial control in a nursing home.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ABSENTEE VOTING FOR ALL AND VARIOUS OTHER REFORMS RELATED TO THE ADMINISTRATION OF ELECTIONS.
purpose: To (1) remove the statutory restrictions on eligibility for absentee voting, (2) allow municipalities to provide by charter for quadrennial municipal elections, (3) authorize the Secretary of the State to recommend changes to procedures for in-person voter registration of disabled individuals, (4) permit assistant municipal clerks running for municipal clerk to perform their official duties on the day of an election, (5) provide for jointly temporarily relieving the registrars of voters of a municipality, (6) allow for Attorney General involvement in matters relating to subpoenas, warrants, other requests and alleged interference at elections, (7) permit the use of high-speed voting tabulators for recanvasses, (8) replace certain references to the Federal Election Commission with references to the Election Assistance Commission, (9) allow seventeen-year-olds who will attain the age of eighteen by the day of an election to vote early or by absentee at such election, (10) address applicability and Americans with Disabilities Act compliance of party rules filed with the Secretary, (11) provide for electronic ballot delivery and return for certain absentee voters, (12) amend the retrieval requirement for absentee ballots from drop boxes, (13) modify the availability time of primary petitions for certain municipal candidates, (14) amend the reasons for which, and the process by which, municipal clerks may be removed from office, (15) amend deadlines for the submission of municipal election returns and the conduct of post-election audits, (16) implement the recommendations of the risk-limiting audits working group, (17) authorize the State Elections Enforcement Commission to also investigate violations of elections-related regulations and not just violations of elections-related statutes, and (18) repeal a training requirement for registrars of voters.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ONLINE SAFETY.
purpose: To (1) establish (A) various requirements concerning artificial intelligence, artificial intelligence systems, artificial intelligence technologies, artificial intelligence companions and automated employment-related decision processes, (B) an Artificial Intelligence Policy Office to be overseen by an Artificial Intelligence Policy Director, (C) an Artificial Intelligence Learning Laboratory Program, (D) a Connecticut AI Academy and require various state agencies to disseminate information concerning said academy, (E) an artificial intelligence working group, and (F) a Connecticut Technology Advisory Board; (2) require (A) subscription-based artificial intelligence providers to make consumer disclosures, (B) frontier developers to implement various internal processes concerning frontier models, (C) synthetic digital content to be detectable as synthetic digital content, (D) the Department of Economic and Community Development to develop and implement a program to bolster artificial intelligence cooperation, (E) the Labor Commissioner to establish an Artificial Intelligence Workforce Research Hub, (F) the Office of Workforce Strategy to develop, implement and promote programs to improve the skills of the state's workforce in relation to artificial intelligence and a plan to create technologist apprenticeships, (G) the Office of Health Strategy to create a program to use artificial intelligence systems to enhance health outcomes for state residents, and (H) the Attorney General, Insurance Commissioner and Commissioner of Consumer Protection to accept applications for safe harbor programs; (3) provide (A) that certain uses of an automated employment-related decision process constitute an unlawful discriminatory practice, (B) that no artificial intelligence technology shall be used to modify or impair a collective bargaining agreement or the role of a designated employee organization, (C) for the designation of artificial intelligence fellows, and (D) for the inclusion of instruction in topics such as the responsible use of emerging technologies in teacher certification preparation programs; and (4) modify (A) the "computer science education and workforce development account", (B) the Technology Talent and Innovation Fund Advisory Committee, and (C) the economic development strategic plan.

cosponsors: Rep. Travis Simms, 140th Dist.

purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction, for taxpayers sixty-five years of age or older, for the amount of any capital gain on the sale of a primary home that is includable in gross income for federal income tax purposes.

cosponsors: Rep. Ben McGorty, 122nd Dist.

purpose: To replace the current tax credit for machinery and equipment with a tax credit for fifty per cent of the amount spent by a corporation on machinery and equipment acquired for and installed in a facility in this state and including a five-year minimum use and recapture provision.

purpose: To increase the qualifying income thresholds for the full Social Security benefits deduction from the personal income tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS RELATED TO ELECTION PROCESSES.
purpose: To (1) provide a mechanism for determining early voting locations when registrars of voters are unable to agree thereon, (2) modify the deadlines by which registrars of voters certify information regarding early voting and same-day election registration locations to the Secretary of the State and allow amendments to such certifications with notice to the Secretary, (3) eliminate the use of envelopes for early voting ballots and allow such ballots to be deposited directly into voting tabulators after being marked, (4) require registrars of voters to submit to the Secretary information regarding early voting and same-day election registration moderators, (5) prohibit early voting and same-day election registration officials from engaging in certain partisan activities on days for which they are appointed to serve, (6) align the provisions for appointment of same-day election registration officials with those for appointment of early voting officials, (7) amend a provision regarding the attachment of party enrollment privileges for consistency with prior changes, (8) prohibit registrars of voters from appointing as moderators certain persons with criminal backgrounds, (9) expand certain post-election procedures for the correction of returns to all towns rather than just those divided into voting districts, (10) provide for notice to the Secretary in certain matters relating to state or federal voting rights, (11) allow for the correction of errors or omissions of timely filed endorsement, nominating or other candidacy-related certificates that would operate to invalidate such certificates if not corrected, (12) provide for the Secretary's preapproval of town's ballots and authority to order corrections in case of omissions or errors, (13) during the ninety days prior to an election or primary, allow the Secretary to go to Superior Court to seek a declaratory judgment on behalf of electors alleging aggrievement, (14) require absentee ballot counters to maintain a log of rejected absentee ballots, (15) for discrepancy recanvasses, (A) require that all districts in a municipality be examined and not just the district in which the discrepancy was found, and (B) allow one party representative to communicate directly with the moderator, (16) exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act all ballots cast at elections, primaries and referenda, and (17) for voter registration information, (A) limit disclosure of birth date information to just the year, and (B) limit use of such information to election-related, scholarly, journalistic, political or governmental purposes.
cosponsors: Rep. Nick Gauthier, 38th Dist.; Rep. Josh Elliott, 88th Dist.
